title: Senior UX Designer (Space Engineers Franchise)
description:
At Keen Software House, we develop large\-scale sandbox simulation games like Space Engineers 1 and Space Engineers 2, built around engineering, construction, destruction, physics, emergent gameplay, and player creativity, together with the proprietary technology that powers them.


**We are looking for a Senior UX Designer with professional experience in the video game industry to join our international team working across Space Engineers and Space Engineers 2\.**



Space Engineers is a complex sandbox game built around engineering, construction, exploration, survival, and player creativity. That complexity is part of what makes the game unique \- but it also creates significant UX challenges.



We are looking for someone who can take real ownership of how players interact with our systems, identify usability problems, and turn complex mechanics and information into clear and intuitive player experiences.



Because we are a relatively small team, we are looking for a hands\-on and versatile UX Designer who can contribute beyond UX theory, wireframes, and documentation. Strong UX expertise is the foundation of the role, but ideally you also bring visual/UI design skills or, alternatively, experience with technical UI prototyping, integration, or implementation. Visual/UI design is particularly valuable for us given the current composition of the team.



You will work closely with Game Design, Art, Engineering, Production, and QA, helping shape both existing and new features from early concepts through to implementation.



We expect you to act as a proactive UX partner \- identify friction, challenge existing solutions when needed, test assumptions, and help us establish stronger UX principles across both games.


**While our studio is based in Prague, we offer the flexibility to work remotely within Europe (CET \+/\- 2 hours).**



If you enjoy challenging work, autonomy, impact, and responsibility, come and join us

  


**Required profile**
--------------------


* **5\+ years of professional experience as a UX Designer, Game UX Designer, or similar role, with significant experience working in the video game industry on PC and/or console games**
* Proven experience designing UX for shipped video games, ideally across multiple features or systems
* Strong portfolio or case studies demonstrating your UX process, including problem definition, user flows, wireframes, prototypes, iteration, and final solutions
* Hands\-on approach to UX design, **with experience in at least one adjacent discipline that allows you to contribute beyond UX documentation – ideally UI/visual design, or alternatively technical UI prototyping, integration, or implementation**
* Strong understanding of interaction design, information architecture, user flows, usability principles, navigation systems, and information hierarchy
* Experience working on sandbox, simulation, strategy, management, or other systems\-heavy games
* Strong experience designing UX for complex and interconnected game systems, such as inventories, building systems, crafting, progression, control schemes, or similar mechanics
* Ability to make complex mechanics and information understandable and intuitive without removing their depth
* Strong wireframing and prototyping skills using Figma or equivalent tools
* Experience creating and evolving UX/UI design systems, interaction patterns, and reusable component libraries
* Experience designing UX for both mouse \& keyboard and controller\-based interaction
* Experience validating UX solutions through usability testing, playtesting, player research, player feedback, analytics, telemetry, or similar methods
* Knowledge of accessibility principles in game UX
* Strong design judgment – able to identify usability problems and their root causes, propose practical solutions, and explain design decisions using player needs, evidence, and clear reasoning
* Ability to work effectively with Game Design, UI Art, Engineering, Production, and QA, understand technical and production constraints, and incorporate them into UX solutions
* Proactive and self\-driven, with the ability to work independently, iterate quickly, receive feedback, and adapt solutions when needed
* Fluent English, spoken and written
* Shares and upholds our High Standards


DUE TO THE HIGH VOLUME OF APPLICATIONS, PLEASE NOTE THAT ONLY CANDIDATES WHO MEET THE KEY REQUIREMENTS OF THE ROLE AND ARE SELECTED FOR THE NEXT STAGE WILL BE CONTACTED.


**Nice to have**
----------------


* Strong visual/UI design skills, including typography, layout, iconography, visual hierarchy, and the ability to take UX concepts through to polished, production\-ready interface designs
* Experience creating or adapting UI assets and working within an established visual language or art direction
* Experience implementing or integrating UI directly in a game engine or proprietary engine
* Experience combining UX design with UI/visual design and/or technical implementation within the same role
* Experience working on live games and improving established systems without disrupting existing player workflows or expectations
* Experience working on sci\-fi, simulation, engineering, or other technically oriented games

**Key responsibilities**
------------------------


* Report to the Production Director and be part of a Game design team
* Take ownership of UX across **Space Engineers and Space Engineers 2**, covering both existing systems and new features
* Identify player friction and usability problems, understand their root causes, and propose practical improvements
* Work with Game Design, UI Art, Engineering, Production, and QA from the early stages of feature development to shape solutions that balance player needs, game design intent, visual clarity, technical feasibility, and production constraints
* Translate complex mechanics, systems, and requirements into clear and intuitive player experiences


**Define and improve:**


* + player flows and navigation
	+ information architecture and interaction patterns
	+ menus, HUD, and in\-game interactions
	+ system feedback
	+ onboarding and discoverability
* Create user flows, wireframes, prototypes, and UX specifications, exploring and validating solutions early before significant development time is invested
* Take solutions beyond UX documentation where appropriate to your skill set – whether through polished UI/visual design, high\-fidelity prototyping, or contributing to UI integration and implementation
* Use playtesting, player feedback, analytics, telemetry, and other available evidence to validate solutions and guide iteration
* Follow UX solutions through development, review implementation, and help ensure the intended player experience is preserved in the final product
* Establish and evolve consistent UX principles, interaction patterns, and design systems across both games
* Clearly communicate UX problems, design decisions, and trade\-offs to stakeholders using evidence, player needs, and clear reasoning
* Balance usability with game depth, technical limitations, development cost, existing player expectations, and long\-term maintainability
* Help improve UX practices across the wider development team and ensure UX is considered throughout development rather than treated as a final review step

**What we value**
-----------------


* Hold yourself to A\-player standards
* **Player\-first thinking without oversimplification** – make complex systems understandable while preserving the depth that makes Space Engineers unique
* **Hands\-on, versatile design** – UX should not stop at diagrams or recommendations; be comfortable turning ideas into tangible solutions and contributing beyond a narrowly defined UX role when needed
* **Problem solving over screen production** – understand the underlying player problem before designing the interface
* **Systems thinking** – understand how individual interactions connect to the broader player experience
* **Strong judgment and prioritisation** – recognise where UX problems have the greatest impact, understand trade\-offs, and focus effort where it matters most
* **Clarity over cleverness** – favour solutions that players can understand naturally, without unnecessary complexity
* **Iteration over attachment** – explore quickly, test assumptions, take feedback well, and change direction when a better solution emerges
* **Ownership and proactivity** – do not wait for perfectly defined UX problems; identify what needs to be solved and help drive it forward
* **Evidence over opinion** – use player behaviour, usability principles, testing, and clear reasoning rather than personal preference
* **Clear and direct communication** – explain UX problems, decisions, and trade\-offs clearly and challenge ideas constructively

**What you'll find at Keen Software House:**
--------------------------------------------


**Impact**


* Leave your mark on one of the most technically ambitious sandbox engineering games ever made.
* Join an international team tackling hard problems


**How we work:**


* Hybrid by default: work from home when you want
* Low bureaucracy, fast decisions


**Time off \& wellbeing**


* 25 days of annual leave.
* Flexible sick leave.


**Workspace**


* Modern offices at Oranžerie, Prague \- quiet focus zones, beautiful garden, great daylight, quality equipment, bike storage, gym and shower, fully stocked kitchen, lunches prepared by our private chefs


**Community**


* Regular team breakfasts, workshops, and relaxed meetups (BBQ, game nights, parties, teambuildings)


DUE TO THE HIGH VOLUME OF APPLICATIONS, PLEASE NOTE THAT ONLY CANDIDATES WHO MEET THE KEY REQUIREMENTS OF THE ROLE AND ARE SELECTED FOR THE NEXT STAGE WILL BE CONTACTED.

title: Lead UI/UX Designer - Mobile Casual F2P Games
description:
The Opportunity
UserWise is looking for an experienced **Lead UI/UX Designer** to own the UI/UX discipline for a a mobile Free\-to\-Play game based on a globally recognized entertainment IP.


This is a **hands\-on leadership role** for someone who can translate game and product designs into clear flows, wireframes, and interactive prototypes before significant art or engineering work begins. You will stay ahead of production, validate interactions early, identify usability problems before they become expensive production problems, and follow features through implementation to ensure the intended player experience survives into the final game.


You will also mentor and work alongside an existing UI/UX Designer, helping establish stronger UX processes, patterns, and quality standards across the project.


This is not a management\-only role. We are looking for someone who is comfortable getting directly into the work — mapping flows, wireframing screens, building prototypes, iterating on UI, reviewing builds, and solving problems alongside Game Design, Art, Product, Engineering, and Production.


What You’ll Do* Own the overall **UX quality and UI/UX discipline** across the game.
* Translate game and product concepts into clear user journeys, flows, wireframes, and interactive prototypes.
* Stay ahead of production by resolving major interaction and usability questions before features move into Art and Engineering.
* Rapidly prototype and compare UX solutions before committing significant production time.
* Own information architecture, navigation, screen hierarchy, interaction patterns, usability, and player comprehension.
* Design intuitive experiences for gameplay, progression, onboarding, rewards, LiveOps, social features, and monetization.
* Proactively identify UX problems through design reviews, prototypes, and playable builds.
* Follow features through implementation and work with Engineering to preserve design intent.
* Improve the **Game Design**  **UX**  **Art**  **Engineering** workflow so features move through production with clearer intent and fewer late\-stage redesigns.
* Establish reusable UX patterns, UI components, interaction standards, and documentation.
* Mentor and work in parallel with another UI/UX Designer while remaining directly involved in execution.
* Partner closely with the Art Director to define and evolve the visual language of the UI, translating the game’s overall art direction into a cohesive, scalable interface system.

  

**Requirements**  

  

What We’re Looking For* Senior or Lead\-level experience designing UI/UX for shipped games.
* Strong shipped experience with **mobile Free\-to\-Play games**, ideally casual or mass\-market titles.
* A portfolio demonstrating both **UX thinking and finished game experiences**, not just polished UI screens.
* Strong ability to turn complex game systems into simple, intuitive player experiences.
* Excellent understanding of mobile interaction design, information architecture, hierarchy, readability, feedback, and usability.
* Experience designing F2P systems such as progression, rewards, FTUE, events, LiveOps, and monetization.
* Strong wireframing and interactive prototyping skills.
* Strong proficiency with **Figma** or equivalent modern product\-design tools.
* Strong UI design fundamentals and the ability to take work beyond low\-fidelity UX when needed.
* Strong product judgment and a proactive approach to identifying and solving experience problems.
* Experience mentoring or providing design direction to other UI/UX Designers.
* Experience collaborating closely with Game Designers, Artists, Engineers, Product Managers, and Producers throughout feature development.
* Familiarity with Unity\-based game production is highly valuable.
* Comfort using AI\-assisted or rapid\-prototyping tools to explore and validate design solutions faster is a plus.


Portfolio
A strong portfolio is essential for this role.


We are particularly interested in examples that demonstrate:

* Shipped mobile and F2P game experiences
* User flows, wireframes, and interactive prototypes
* Evolution from early UX concepts to final shipped UI
* Gameplay, onboarding, progression, rewards, LiveOps, or monetization UX
* Examples where you simplified a complex feature or solved a meaningful usability problem
* Your individual contribution versus the work of the broader team


Case studies showing **how you arrived at a solution** are especially valuable. We want to understand the problem, the alternatives you explored, the decisions you made, and how the experience evolved through implementation.

 **Benefits**  

  

Why Join UserWise* Own the UX of a flagship mobile game based on a globally recognized entertainment IP.
* Have significant influence over the product while it is still actively being shaped.
* Work in a lean team where UI/UX is central to the game experience rather than a downstream production function.
* Establish the UX processes, standards, and design systems that guide the project.
* Experiment with rapid prototyping and AI\-assisted workflows to increase iteration speed and design quality.
* 100% remote, flexible work with a small, experienced team.


What We Offer* Market\-competitive compensation
* Paid Time Off
* Performance Bonus
* Annual Performance Reviews

### **Diverse collaborators**

### **Resilient trailblazers**

### **Agile movers**


Seize ownership and excel with autonomy to enjoy the constant rush of ground\-breaking discovery. Your ability to anticipate sudden shifts and adapt swiftly will prove critical as you make your mark in an environment that rewards initiative and resilience.


**Responsibilities**
--------------------


**Job ID** R\-258650 **Date posted** 09/04/2026
**Role Overview**


A senior engineering leadership role responsible for the technical direction, hands\-on delivery, and production scaling of AI solutions across enterprise enabling functions — including **HR, Finance, Procurement, Legal, Audit, Compliance, and Business Development**.


This is a **builder\-leader role**. The Engineering Director combines deep hands\-on AI engineering — designing and shipping multi\-agent systems, RAG pipelines, and governed AI applications — with the technical leadership required to drive a team from opportunity identification through to production deployment. They bring a rare and deliberate combination: the ability to move from idea to working proof\-of\-concept in days, alongside significant depth in **AI governance**, **operational resilience**, and **regulatory compliance** — not as adjacent knowledge, but as a core professional discipline that shapes how they build, assess, and operate AI systems.


The role sits within the Enterprise AI function and works in close partnership with enterprise technology, data engineering, technology governance, legal, information security, and functional stakeholders to deliver AI that is **production\-grade, auditable, and compliant from the first commit** — not retrofitted at the end. Given geographic considerations, the role carries particular responsibility for navigating multi\-jurisdictional data sovereignty, regulatory divergence, and cross\-border AI governance — ensuring systems are defensible under all applicable regulatory regimes.


**Context**


Enabling functions — HR, Finance, Procurement, Legal, Audit, and Compliance — govern how an organisation hires, contracts, spends, reports, partners, audits, and maintains compliance. They represent **high\-value AI opportunities** and **high\-consequence environments** — where outputs carry regulatory, financial, and reputational weight. Realising value at scale requires engineering leadership that can navigate complex data landscapes, build for reuse, and embed governance, human oversight, and operational resilience into architecture decisions from the outset.


These AI applications do not exist in a vacuum. Each system must be governed — classified, registered, monitored, auditable, and defensible to regulators, auditors, and internal oversight functions. The governance and resilience challenge is twofold: building AI systems that are *themselves* resilient and well\-governed, and ensuring the frameworks, processes, and controls that surround those systems are robust, proportionate, and continuously maintained. The role demands someone who has operated at this intersection for a significant portion of their career — not someone encountering governance as a new discipline.


This role is designed for an engineer who has already built AI applications inside a **large, regulated enterprise**, who has **demonstrated experience delivering AI solutions across multiple enabling functions** (e.g., HR, Finance, Procurement, Legal, Audit), who has significant experience governing AI systems and embedding operational resilience disciplines around them, and who treats regulatory requirements as **architecture decisions** — not compliance checkboxes.


**Key Responsibilities**


**1\. Technical Direction \& Architecture**


* Lead the engineering roadmap for AI across enabling functions, aligning architecture, delivery sequencing, and capability development to business priorities across **HR, Finance, Procurement, Legal, Audit, and Compliance**
* Set architectural direction for scalable, governed AI platforms — designing for **modularity**, **cross\-functional reuse**, and **compliance from the outset**
* Make high\-consequence technical decisions on architecture, build\-vs\-buy, model strategy (foundation models, fine\-tuning, multi\-provider orchestration, RAG), and integration patterns
* Drive **platform thinking over project thinking** — building shared components, reusable agent patterns, and common governance instrumentation that accelerate delivery across the portfolio
* Ensure architecture accounts for data sovereignty requirements — model routing, data residency, and hosting decisions that respect jurisdictional boundaries and cross\-border transfer requirements
* Shape investment cases for senior stakeholders, articulating engineering decisions in terms of scalability, risk, regulatory defensibility, and value creation

**2\. Hands\-On AI Engineering \& Delivery**


* Design and ship **multi\-agent LLM architectures** across multiple model providers, choosing models against product requirements and compliance constraints — including sovereignty\-aware routing through region\-specific infrastructure where required
* Build **RAG pipelines** over real enterprise corpora with named single\-purpose agents, hallucination guards before any user\-facing output, and immutable audit logging at every stage
* Use AI\-assisted development tooling to compress delivery from months to days, while keeping architecture decisions, model routing, and guardrails under deliberate human control
* Lead technical design for complex solutions spanning enabling functions — **HR policy automation, contract risk scoring, procurement analytics, compliance monitoring, financial forecasting, audit analytics, and document intelligence** — with governance built in from the first build
* Ensure rapid experimentation capability with clear engineering gates between proof\-of\-concept, pilot, and production — measuring against real data and real success criteria, not mock demos

**3\. AI Governance \& Regulatory Compliance**


*This is a defining pillar of the role.* The organisation requires an engineering leader with significant, demonstrated experience in AI governance — someone who has designed governance frameworks, built governance tooling, and operated in governance roles — not simply complied with governance requirements set by others.


* **Governance architecture**: Design and operate the governance structures that surround AI applications — classification and tiering, risk assessment, model registration, approval workflows, ongoing monitoring obligations, and decommissioning criteria
* **Regulatory compliance (multi\-jurisdictional)**: Ensure systems meet requirements under applicable data protection laws, AI\-specific regulations (e.g., EU AI Act risk classification, emerging national AI frameworks), and sector\-specific operational resilience expectations — navigating divergence and maintaining defensibility under multiple regimes
* **Data sovereignty**: Design data\-residency and model\-routing approaches that respect adequacy arrangements, data\-transfer mechanisms, and sovereignty constraints — ensuring processing is appropriately separated by jurisdiction where required, with sovereign model options (e.g., region\-specific cloud deployments, local model hosting)
* **Responsible agentic architecture**: Design systems where AI agents reason autonomously but consequential action is human\-gated — with every decision writing an audit row recording what model decided what, on what evidence
* **Governance\-by\-design**: Embed deterministic classification/routing layers, human\-in\-the\-loop oversight, model/data cards, and full audit trails into standard engineering practice — treating these as first\-class architecture components, not afterthoughts
* **Second\-line posture**: Ensure governance tooling supports independent review — maintaining separation between the teams that build and the functions that assess, with tool design reflecting this control
* **Domain\-specific requirements**: Ensure AI systems handling financially material data (Finance), legally privileged documents (Legal), employee\-sensitive information (HR), supplier\-confidential data (Procurement), or audit evidence (Audit) meet the specific governance and evidential standards those domains require (e.g., SOX, legal privilege, chain\-of\-custody, employment law)
* **Lifecycle governance**: Own the ongoing governance obligations for live AI systems — periodic re\-assessment, performance review against stated tolerances, change\-impact assessment, and documented decision trails for model updates or retirement

**4\. Operational Resilience — For AI Systems**


*The second defining pillar.* The role requires significant experience in operational resilience as a discipline — not just awareness, but hands\-on engineering delivery.


* Engineer operational resilience into AI applications — circuit breakers, provider fallbacks, graceful degradation, fail\-safe defaults, and dependency\-aware architecture so essential functions survive outages
* **Design for failure**: assume model providers, data sources, and integration points will fail, and ensure user\-facing services degrade safely rather than catastrophically
* Ensure AI systems are mapped against the organisation's important business services framework — with defined impact tolerances, recovery objectives, and tested failover paths

**5\. Engineering Leadership \& Team Development**


* Lead a multi\-disciplinary engineering team comprising software, ML, data, and platform engineers — recruiting, developing, and retaining strong technical talent
* Set engineering culture and standards for **code quality**, **testing**, **documentation**, **peer review**, and **production readiness**
* Develop senior technical contributors and engineering leads — building depth and succession within the team
* Mentor and enable non\-technical colleagues across enabling functions to ship their own AI applications, building AI literacy across **HR, Finance, Procurement, Legal, Audit, and Compliance**
* Manage capacity and team topology — making deliberate choices about structure, specialisation, and balance across discovery, delivery, and sustainment

**6\. Delivery \& Production Excellence**


* Drive end\-to\-end engineering delivery from architecture through to production deployment, scaling, monitoring, and lifecycle management
* Partner with enterprise technology teams to leverage shared platforms, infrastructure, and services — ensuring solutions are built on common foundations and contribute back to enterprise capability
* Establish and enforce standards for model serving, data pipelines, API design, integration patterns, security, and observability
* Drive **MLOps maturity** including CI/CD, automated testing, performance monitoring, incident management, and capacity planning
* Own the data engineering approach for AI across enabling functions — pipelines, feature stores, and data products designed for quality, governance, and reuse
* Establish data quality, lineage, and governance standards appropriate for financially material data, legally privileged documents, employee PII, and personally identifiable information subject to applicable data protection laws

**7\. Model Quality, Drift \& Assurance**


* Establish **model\-drift and bias monitoring** across the portfolio — measuring divergence across runs and generating targeted refinement recommendations
* Design and operate AI red\-team capability to probe and refine model outputs before release and on an ongoing basis
* Build automated fairness testing, explainability pipelines, and decision audit trails embedded in standard workflows
* Own technical risk management across the portfolio including model degradation, data quality drift, dependency risk, and integration risk
* Ensure model assurance reporting meets the expectations of internal audit, technology governance, and external regulators

**8\. Scaling Through Partnership**


* Work in close partnership with enterprise technology to align on shared infrastructure, platform services, tooling, and engineering standards
* Identify and scale opportunities across enabling functions — recognising where a solution proven in one function (e.g., contract intelligence in Legal) can be adapted and deployed in another (e.g., supplier risk in Procurement)
* Engage external technology partners strategically — co\-developing or integrating capabilities where they accelerate delivery or provide specialist functionality
* Shape joint programmes with partners, defining technical scope, integration architecture, and quality standards — ensuring partnerships deliver production\-grade outcomes
* Build a **scaling model** that leverages shared services, external partners, and cross\-functional reuse to multiply impact without proportional headcount growth

**9\. Stakeholder Partnership \& Adoption**


* Serve as a credible technical partner to functional leaders across **HR, Finance, Procurement, Legal, Audit, and Compliance** — providing counsel on AI opportunity, risk, regulatory posture, and investment
* Work as an **internal consultant**: run discovery with each business unit, surface real problems, frame concrete use cases with measurable success criteria, and drive adoption through continuous UX iteration and direct user\-feedback loops
* Translate between engineering complexity and business strategy — communicating trade\-offs, timelines, and constraints so leaders can make informed decisions
* Measure success by **real adoption and operational impact**, not by demonstrations — building KPI/KRI frameworks giving leaders visibility into usage, quality, and value

**10\. Enterprise AI Integration**


* Represent enabling functions within enterprise AI leadership forums and architecture governance, ensuring alignment on standards, platform strategy, and shared services
* Contribute to enterprise AI governance including architecture review boards, AI policy development, and standards evolution
* Drive reuse and knowledge sharing — identifying where governance and resilience patterns developed for enabling functions can accelerate delivery elsewhere
* Advocate for enabling function requirements within the broader enterprise technology agenda, ensuring platform priorities reflect the needs of regulated, process\-critical functions

We're a venture\-backed scale\-up with $96M raised from investors in Europe and the US. **Role Overview**
This role provides Quality Engineering leadership across Design Controls, Risk Management, and Quality System requirements throughout the product development lifecycle, partnering with Engineering, Product Management, Clinical, Regulatory Affairs, and Project Management to bring new products and design changes to commercial products in compliance with global medical device regulations. title: Head of Engineering, Rewards
description:
**Who we are**



Moniepoint Inc. is Africa's all\-in\-one financial platform, helping 20 million businesses and individuals access seamless payments, banking, credit, cross\-border, and business management tools each month.



As Nigeria's largest merchant acquirer, we power most of the country's point\-of\-sale (POS) transactions. Through our subsidiaries, Moniepoint Inc. processes over $250 billion in digital payment transaction value annually.


**Why Spain**



Some of our most mission\-critical team members are based in Spain, having joined us from companies like Wise and Glovo. Moniepoint is one of the largest and fastest\-growing digital banks in Africa, and this is an opportunity to work on genuinely impactful problems: disrupting financial services at scale in emerging markets, and building systems and products that process hundreds of billions of dollars in transaction volume annually for tens of millions of people.



So, now we are looking for our Head of Engineering, Rewards to join us in Spain.


**About The Role**



Rewards is one of the most strategically important platforms at Moniepoint, and it is being built into a dedicated charter with its own engineering and product leadership. The platform sits at the centre of our retention strategy across a user base of approximately 23 million people.



Today the platform does one thing: cashback. It works, but it has barely scratched the surface of what rewards can be, and the cashback product itself is not yet built to the depth it deserves. The ambition is to evolve it into a full rewards, retention, engagement and personalisation platform — and to do that across the full 360 degrees of our network. That means rewards for our business customers, rewards for our consumer customers, and rewards for the sales agents who drive our distribution. Very few companies get to design this from close to a blank page at this scale.



The Head of Engineering owns that platform end to end. You will inherit a team of nine engineers, including an Engineering Manager, and build the organisation out from there — the current expectation is a minimum of three product units and upwards of 25 people, though the eventual shape is genuinely yours to define. Your first objective is to get the best possible performance out of the cashback product we already have. From there, you will work with Growth, Sales and Marketing to determine what we build for acquisition and retention, and roll it out across every customer we serve.



This is a consumer\-facing product engineering role, and that is the most important thing to understand about it. Rewards is won or lost on experimentation, personalisation, and the quality of the experience in a customer's hands. We are looking for a leader who has built and shipped direct\-to\-consumer products at scale, who is fluent in experimentation and A/B testing, and who has real depth in front\-end and mobile engineering — not a purely backend platform leader.



Moniepoint runs a Domain CTO model. We view our Heads of Engineering as the CTO of their domain: you own the technical roadmap, the architecture, the delivery, and the organisation beneath you. You will have full autonomy over engineering strategy, architecture, hiring, operating cadence and roadmap trade\-offs.



You will report functionally to our Group CTO, with a dual reporting line into the Product leader for Rewards. That second line is a delivery relationship rather than a seniority one — engineering and product are peers here, and you will build the team to full capacity together. Your responsibilities as Head of Engineering, Rewards includes:


* Owning the technical strategy, architecture and roadmap for the Rewards Platform end to end.
* Improving the performance, reliability and depth of the existing cashback product as an immediate first priority.
* Evolving cashback into a broader rewards, retention, engagement and personalisation platform serving business customers, consumer customers and sales agents.
* Building the engineering organisation from its current base \- structuring product units, hiring engineers and Engineering Managers, and leading through those managers as the team scales.
* Establishing a strong experimentation culture: A/B testing, cohort analysis, and measurement that lets the team learn quickly what actually changes customer behaviour.
* Working closely with Growth, Sales and Marketing to translate acquisition and retention objectives into product and engineering initiatives.
* Owning the customer\-facing experience of rewards across mobile and web, including how quickly and reliably customers receive what they have earned.
* Define architecture standards, engineering processes and quality metrics, and own the engineering health of the domain — incidents, production defects, deployment frequency, change failure rate, and developer experience.
* Build the platform to serve customers across multiple geographies as Moniepoint expands.
* Partner with Product to define the rewards\-specific metrics and OKRs that do not yet exist, and hold the team to them.


**Who You Are**


* Direct\-to\-consumer product engineering at scale. You have built and shipped products used directly by large consumer audiences, and you understand what moves engagement and retention. This is the defining requirement of the role.
* Genuine front\-end and mobile depth. You have led or personally built consumer\-facing mobile and web experiences. A backend\-only background, however strong, is not what this role needs.
* Experimentation and growth engineering. Hands\-on experience running A/B tests, feature flagging, and measurement frameworks, and using the results to drive product decisions rather than to justify them.
* At least 5 years of experience managing managers — leading an engineering organisation through other engineering leaders, not a single team.
* Hands\-on technical leadership. You are still close to the code. We expect a meaningful proportion of hands\-on engineering time and technical credibility with the engineers you lead.
* 10\+ years of overall software engineering experience, with at least 5 years leading engineering teams through growth phases.
* Comfort with our backend environment — Java and Spring Boot — and the ability to lead backend engineers credibly, even if it is not where your own depth sits.
* Experience building and scaling an engineering organisation from a small base, including hiring and developing Engineering Managers.
* Strong collaboration with commercial stakeholders — growth, marketing and sales — and the ability to translate business objectives into engineering work.
* Rewards, loyalty, gamification, personalisation or growth platform experience is a strong advantage but is not required.
* Fintech or payments experience is an advantage, not a requirement.


**Cultural Alignment**



As well, we assess every candidate across eight dimensions that define how great leaders operate at Moniepoint. We look for evidence of all eight throughout the process, not just in a single conversation.


* Customer Obsession: Build deep empathy for users. Solve problems intuitively, and fix root causes, not just tickets.
* Craft: Master the fundamentals. Reason from first principles, make trade\-offs explicit, and raise the bar on quality.
* Systemisation: Turn repeating decisions into scalable mechanisms. Reduce cognitive load and raise engineering quality.
* Urgency: Move with disciplined speed. Act autonomously within scope, remove friction, and escalate risks early.
* Ownership: Treat the platform as your own. Take initiative across boundaries and follow through without reminders.
* No Ego: Put the mission first. Share credit, welcome debate, and never protect status over team outcomes.
* Candour: Surface uncomfortable truths and risks early. Intelligent failure is welcome; concealment is not.
* Integrity: Stay truthful and ethically consistent. Refuse toxic behavior. Performance without integrity is unacceptable.

title: Head of Engineering, Field Verification
description:
**Who we are**



Moniepoint Inc. is Africa's all\-in\-one financial platform, helping 20 million businesses and individuals access seamless payments, banking, credit, cross\-border, and business management tools each month.



As Nigeria's largest merchant acquirer, we power most of the country's point\-of\-sale (POS) transactions. Through our subsidiaries, Moniepoint Inc. processes over $250 billion in digital payment transaction value annually.


**Why Spain**



Some of our most mission\-critical team members are based in Spain, having joined us from companies like Wise and Glovo. Moniepoint is one of the largest and fastest\-growing digital banks in Africa, and this is an opportunity to work on genuinely impactful problems: disrupting financial services at scale in emerging markets, and building systems and products that process hundreds of billions of dollars in transaction volume annually for tens of millions of people.



So, now we are looking for our Head of Engineering, Field Verification to join us in Spain.


**About the role**



Field Verification is how Moniepoint knows that the people and businesses on our platform are real. Every Moniepoint customer, retail and business, requires a completed field verification as part of KYC. The platform coordinates physical, in\-person checks — verifying individuals, business owners, business addresses and loan guarantors — and it serves nearly every part of the company: onboarding, loans, compliance and the fraud team.



The system works today. A back office gives each business unit visibility and control over its own verification requests. A mobile\-friendly web app puts the work in the hands of Field Verification Officers and the cluster leads who manage them across local government areas. An API layer lets other business units push verification requests in and receive results back by webhook, and an assignment algorithm routes each request to an officer close enough to carry it out.



We want to be straightforward about the rest. This domain has never had a dedicated engineering leader, and that is the single biggest constraint on it. The team is one lean, cross\-functional squad — an Engineering Manager, four engineers and a QA — carrying verification volume for the entire customer base. They have done that impressively well, but running lean means running in keep\-the\-lights\-on mode, and a long list of things that would make this platform substantially better has been waiting for someone to own it.



That list is the role. Trip and route management, so an officer can plan an optimal day across several sites rather than making a separate journey for each one — today we pay for a round trip per verification, and the logistics are nowhere near optimal. Capacity management. A native mobile app, wanted for a long time and never resourced. Liveness and identity verification tooling, exposed as APIs the rest of the business can build on. And as Moniepoint expands into markets where identity verification is as difficult as it is in Nigeria, Kenya among them, a platform that works beyond a single country.



There is a great deal of room to build here. Whoever takes this on will set the direction rather than inherit someone else's plan, on a system that already carries real weight for the business.


**As Head of Engineering, Field Verification, your responsibilities will include:**


* Owning the technical strategy, architecture and roadmap for the Field Verification platform end to end, and setting direction for a domain that has been running without dedicated engineering leadership.
* Moving the platform from keep\-the\-lights\-on operation to deliberate, prioritised development.
* Leading and growing the existing cross\-functional team, and building the organisation out as scope expands.
* Building the operational efficiency layer — trip and route optimisation, task allocation and capacity management for field officers.
* Owning the platform's client\-facing surface: the APIs and webhooks that other business units integrate with, and the back office those units rely on.
* Delivering a native mobile experience for field officers.
* Ensuring verification data is structured, auditable and fit for compliance scrutiny.
* Building for multi\-country expansion as Moniepoint enters new markets.
* Partnering closely with Product and with the business units that depend on the platform — onboarding, loans, compliance and fraud.
* Defining architecture standards, engineering processes and quality metrics, and hiring and developing engineers and Engineering Managers.


**Who you are**


* You have built things yourself, and grew into leadership from there. We are explicit about this: we are not looking for someone who moved into management early and has led from a distance since. We want an engineer who became a leader.
* You are capable across disciplines. Backend, web and mobile. This platform spans all three and you will need credibility in each — a specialist in one layer will struggle here.
* You have built platforms, not just products**.** Systems used by several distinct groups of users and internal business units, with the flexibility to serve requirements you did not anticipate.
* You are a problem solver first. We would rather have someone adaptable than someone with the exact domain experience. Having built across different industries — fintech, e\-commerce, logistics or otherwise — is a positive signal, not a scattered CV.
* You have 10\+ years of overall software engineering experience, with substantial hands\-on production engineering and strong backend depth. Our backend environment is Java and Spring Boot.
* You have at least 5 years of engineering leadership, including managing Engineering Managers.
* You collaborate well with product and business stakeholders, and can translate operational requirements into engineering solutions.
* Experience working with location and geospatial data is a strong plus, including map integrations.
* Experience with route, trip or delivery optimisation is a strong plus.
* Experience building for compliance — where data must be structured to evidence what was done and when — is a strong plus.
* Experience with identity, KYC or verification platforms is a plus. None of these four are requirements.

  


**Cultural Alignment**



As well, we assess every candidate across eight dimensions that define how great leaders operate at Moniepoint. We look for evidence of all eight throughout the process, not just in a single conversation.


* Customer Obsession: Build deep empathy for users. Solve problems intuitively, and fix root causes, not just tickets.
* Craft: Master the fundamentals. Reason from first principles, make trade\-offs explicit, and raise the bar on quality.
* Systemisation: Turn repeating decisions into scalable mechanisms. Reduce cognitive load and raise engineering quality.
* Urgency: Move with disciplined speed. Act autonomously within scope, remove friction, and escalate risks early.
* Ownership: Treat the platform as your own. Take initiative across boundaries and follow through without reminders.
* No Ego: Put the mission first. Share credit, welcome debate, and never protect status over team outcomes.
* Candour: Surface uncomfortable truths and risks early. Intelligent failure is welcome; concealment is not.
* Integrity: Stay truthful and ethically consistent. Refuse toxic behavior. Performance without integrity is unacceptable.

  


**What Success Looks Like**


* The domain has clear technical ownership and direction for the first time.
* The team out of keep\-the\-lights\-on mode and delivering against a prioritised roadmap.
* Measurable improvement in field officer efficiency — more verifications per trip, lower cost per verification.
* A native mobile experience shipped for field officers.
* Verification data that stands up to compliance scrutiny across every business unit the platform serves.
* The platform ready to support a new market.
* A team grown beyond its current size, with a strong bench of engineers and managers.


**Why Join Us**


* A genuinely greenfield mandate on a system that already matters. Every customer Moniepoint onboards passes through this platform.
* A lean, capable team making outsized impact, and the remit to build the organisation around them.
* Breadth: backend, web, mobile, location data, compliance and operational optimisation in one domain.
* Be part of a mission\-driven company expanding access to financial services for millions of businesses and individuals.


**What To Expect in The Hiring Process**


* A preliminary phone call with the recruiter.
* 60 minute High level System Design round with one of our Engineering Managers.

* Collaborate with merchandising and retail teams to align VM execution with product strategy and stock priorities.
* Act as a key point of coordination between central VM and local teams, ensuring smooth communication and execution.
* Maintain a proactive, solution\-oriented approach, adapting quickly to evolving business needs and priorities.
### **Profile**

**What is important for the role:**

* Degree or academic background in Visual Merchandising, Fashion, Business, or related field (or equivalent experience).
* 2–4 years of experience in Visual Merchandising, ideally within the luxury or fashion industry.
* Experience working with RTW and Accessories categories is a plus.
* Strong understanding of retail and wholesale environments.
* Excellent attention to detail with a strong visual sensibility.
* Creative mindset with a commercial approach.
* Strong interest in fashion, styling, and current trends.
* Excellent communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to work across multiple markets and teams.
* Organised, proactive, and adaptable.
* A collaborative team player with a positive and hands\-on attitude.
* Ability to manage multiple priorities in a dynamic environment.
* Proficiency in MS Office and design tools (e.g., Photoshop is a plus).
* Fluent in English (Spanish and Italian are a plus).
* Willingness to travel frequently across South Europe.
### **Additional information**

**About LOEWE:**

Founded in Spain in 1846, LOEWE is the second\-oldest luxury fashion house in the world. Since 2025, the House is under the creative direction of Jack McCollough and Lazaro Hernandez, guided by a rich artistic sensibility and an imaginative exploration of craft. This new chapter builds on core sensibilities of LOEWE: an intellectual and playful approach to fashion, the vibrant spirit of Spanish lifestyle, and unmatched leather expertise.


At LOEWE we are committed to a culture that welcomes all, regardless of gender, ethnicity, socioeconomic background and abilities, including people with disabilities of all types. Our aim is for everyone to feel valued, included, and empowered to contribute their best.


***LOEWE***
**MAISON**

title: Associate Director, Real Estate Investment Banking
description:
JLL supports the Whole You, personally and professionally.
  
  

Our people at JLL are shaping the future of real estate for a better world by combining world class services, advisory and technology to our clients. Associate / Associate Director SCS
  
  

The Role
  
  

We are seeking an Associate/Associate Director to join our EMEA Strategic Capital Solutions team based in London, Madrid or Frankfurt. The team combines our Real Estate Investment Banking and Pan European Capital Markets Sector teams as an integrated, market\-leading platform.
  
We specialise in complex, multi\-stakeholder transactions including large portfolio sales, corporate M\&A, recapitalisations, joint ventures, new funds and structured equity transactions. The team operates from offices in London, Madrid, and Frankfurt, within a highly motivated, high\-performing, investment\-banking\-style environment that values initiative, analytical rigor, and ambition.
  
As Associate/Associate Director, you'll be a trusted member of the team supporting directors throughout the full life cycle of projects. You will play an active role in live client processes, participating in client meetings and maintaining relationships. You'll also mentor analysts, graduates and junior team members, helping develop their financial analysis skills and understanding of the real estate market.
  
  

Key Responsibilities
  
  

**Execution Leadership:** Ensure quality and timeliness of all client\-facing materials and transaction documentation while coordinating multiple workstreams, anticipating execution obstacles, and demonstrating ownership of transaction outcomes.
  
  

**Transaction Management:** Manage complex transactions including joint ventures, corporate M\&A, portfolio and asset sales, maintaining clear communication between multiple stakeholders while managing competing priorities across simultaneous transactions.
  
  

**Sector Specialisation Development:** Build depth of market intelligence within preferred asset classes or product types, producing high\-quality sector/product\-specific technical analyses
  
  

**Client\-Facing Capability:** Present marketing materials and transaction updates with professionalism, respond effectively to technical client questions, and serve as point of contact externally.
  
  

**Financial Modelling and Analysis:** Create and interpret financial models for large portfolio sales, corporate M\&A, joint ventures, and structured equity transactions, providing strategic advice based on financial analysis and market trends with efficient turnaround times.
  
  

**Pitch Preparation and Business Development:** Support preparation and coordination of pitches for potential projects, develop creative business opportunities, and execute investor marketing strategies to grow the team pipeline.
  
  

**Cross\-functional Collaboration:** Develop connections with local teams to support investment processes, manage research team outputs, coordinate with marketing teams, and build relationships with internal specialist teams including sustainability.
  
  

**Team Leadership and Development:** Effectively supervise analyst team members on assigned deals, mentor graduates and junior team members on financial analysis and appraisal outputs, and support their professional development.
  
  

What Are We Looking For?
  
Minimum 3 years of demonstrated experience in investment banking / corporate finance with exposure to real estate, or real estate capital markets
  
Sustained excellence across execution responsibilities over 3\+ years
  
Strong financial modeling capabilities \- comfortable building and critically analyzing financial and valuation models and working with complex operating data
  
Sound understanding of financial statements and how operational metrics drive platform / property value
  
Deep market knowledge including submarkets, rental trends, and recent transactions
  
Consistent leadership on transactions
  
Excellent project management and organisational abilities with proven ability to manage multiple workstreams
  
Outstanding communication and interpersonal skills with ability to manage multiple stakeholders
  
Proven track record in independent client relationship management and business development
  
Deep market knowledge including submarkets, rental trends, and recent transactions
  
Meticulous attention to detail
  
Proactive attitude and ability to work independently while contributing to team objectives
  
Ability to mentor and develop junior team members
  
Meticulous attention to detail
  
Expert proficiency in MS Office (Excel, Word, PowerPoint)
  
Willingness to travel regularly throughout Europe for client meetings and site inspections
  
Additional European languages are beneficial but not essential
  
  

What You Can Expect From Us
  
  

At JLL, we make sure that you become the best version of yourself by helping you realize your full potential in an entrepreneurial and inclusive work environment. Our Total Rewards program reflects our commitment to helping you achieve your career ambitions, recognizing your contributions, investing in your well\-being, and providing competitive benefits and pay.
  
  

**We offer:**  

Opportunities for career growth and professional development
  
Collaborative and innovative work environment
  
Competitive salary and performance\-based bonuses
  
Global exposure within a leading real estate services firm
  
  

If this job description resonates with you, we encourage you to apply even if you don’t meet all of the requirements below. We’re interested in getting to know you and what you bring to the table!
  
  

Personalized benefits that support personal well\-being and growth:
  
  

JLL recognizes the impact that the workplace can have on your wellness, so we offer a supportive culture and comprehensive benefits package that prioritizes mental, physical and emotional health.
  
  

About JLL –
  
  

We’re JLL—a leading professional services and investment management firm specializing in real estate. We have operations in over 80 countries and a workforce of over 102,000 individuals around the world who help real estate owners, occupiers and investors achieve their business ambitions. As a global Fortune 500 company, we also have an inherent responsibility to drive sustainability and corporate social responsibility. That’s why we’re committed to our purpose to shape the future of real estate for a better world. We’re using the most advanced technology to create rewarding opportunities, amazing spaces and sustainable real estate solutions for our clients, our people, and our communities.
  
  

Our core values of teamwork, ethics and excellence are also fundamental to everything we do and we’re honored to be recognized with awards for our success by organizations both globally and locally.
  
  

Creating a diverse and inclusive culture where we all feel welcomed, valued and empowered to achieve our full potential is important to who we are today and where we’re headed in the future. And we know that unique backgrounds, experiences and perspectives help us think bigger, spark innovation and succeed together.

title: Global Head of People & Organization
location: Sant Cugat del Vallès, CT, ES
description:
##### **About our company**

Innovamat is an educational organization specialized in mathematics teaching. Founded in Barcelona in 2017, Innovamat provides schools with a comprehensive, evidence\-based mathematics program spanning from Early Childhood Education through Secondary School, developed together with leading experts in mathematics didactics, cognition, and neuroscience.


The program integrates curriculum, teacher training, assessment, and intervention into a single coherent system. Present in 9 countries and serving more than 720,000 students, Innovamat is one of the few organizations in the sector with efficacy data independently validated by external research institutions. It is also the first non\-U.S. organization to successfully complete the California State Board of Education's adoption process for a core mathematics curriculum.

##### **About the Role and Why It’s Special**

Innovamat is turning 10\. We've gotten here with 350 people across 9 countries and a stable financial position. That puts us in a position **to bet on and invest in the next phase of our People function and bring it to the highest level of importance in the company.** This isn't a vacancy to cover an operational need: it's a strategic decision about how we want Innovamat to grow in its next decade.


Today there is a solid, committed People team, distributed across HQ, EU, LATAM, and the United States, but without a global system that unifies levels, compensation architecture, performance evaluation, onboarding, and management training. The person joining as Global Head of People will be **the first person responsible for building that system at a global scale, and will do so at the moment of greatest growth in our history.**


They will report directly to the CEO, building the organization's people direction, and will collaborate directly with the rest of the leadership team. They will also be responsible for our current globally\-scoped People team, made up of both the Headquarters team and the teams across the different geographies where we operate.


We are not looking for someone who wants to focus on administrative processes, nor someone who prefers to design and delegate. **We are looking for someone who knows how to move between strategy and execution**: someone who understands the day\-to\-day of the business in depth and wants to make People a strategic function and key ally to the business.


Our philosophy is clear: we believe in empowering managers as the ultimate owners of their teams' people. We want to find the balance between process and bureaucracy and move at high speed. This person will play a key role in establishing the frameworks and structure needed so that speed doesn't compromise quality, so we continue to care for our talent and culture, and so we maintain our bar of excellence as we grow the team.

##### **Key Responsibilities**

At this pivotal moment for Innovamat, we're looking for someone who will take on this challenge as their own and be able to mobilize and make an impact across the entire organization.

**People Strategy, Architecture \& Organization**

* Design the first levels and compensation bands architecture for all 9 countries.
* Define which metrics we monitor and with which tools, consistently.
* Define the framework for the benefits architecture by country, setting common principles at a global level, with the flexibility needed to adapt to each market.
* Redesign the performance evaluation system, with two annual cycles and real calibration across departments and geographies.
* Implement an executive people analytics dashboard for the CEO and the Leadership Team with key metrics.
* Maintain the balance between organizational growth and as flat a structure as possible, establishing the minimum bureaucracy needed at each stage.
* Track spans, layers, and revenue per employee as core metrics.
* Identify management needs before they become a problem.

**People Business Partnering \& Development**

* Lead the global team of People BPs (HQ, Spain, Italy, LATAM, US).
* Build the management training program.
* Implement a systematic, measured onboarding process across all countries.
* Define a system to identify top performers and cases of underperformance.
* Develop the employer brand and our own talent pipeline at a global level.

**Talent Acquisition**

* Lead the global Talent team (HQ, Spain, Italy, LATAM, US).
* Own the hiring standard, consistently evaluating each candidate's purpose, learning ability, and reliability, with a unified criteria across countries.
* Define and track hiring metrics
* Prioritize closing critical positions in product, artificial intelligence, and the United States market.

**People Operations, Processes \& Employee Support**

* Define the company's people rhythm: what cycles exist, when, and who runs them, at a global level.
* Maintain a small number of processes, with a high/flawless execution standard across all geographies.
* Ensure consistency and internal communication across our three markets (HQ, Spain, Italy, LATAM, and the United States) with three different languages in use.
* Define and roll out the method for communicating complex organizational decisions.

**Partnering with the Leadership Team**


This is the most valuable part of the role and the one that takes the longest to develop. It will unfold in the following phases:

* **Phase 1:** Contribute, together with the CEO, to designing the Leadership Team's performance evaluation framework, as a specific application of the company's general evaluation system.
* **Phase 2:** Develop the Leadership Team's evaluation cycles, in collaboration with the CEO, with increasing autonomy as the cycles mature.
* **Phase 3:** Act as People Business Partner to the Leadership Team, responsible for providing data\-driven assessments on the performance and continuity of its members.

##### **What We are Looking For**

**Experience**

* 5 to 10 years of work experience building or leading people systems, teams, or processes from scratch.
* 4\+ years of experience leading people or project teams with real business accountability (P\&L, budget, or quota). A background in HR is strongly preferred, but not required.
* Experience operating in multi\-country environments, with teams and stakeholders across different geographies and time zones.
* The following will be positively valued:


	+ Experience in top\-tier strategy consulting, followed by an operational stage.
	+ Prior experience in international organizations or in expanding markets, particularly the United States.
	+ Experience in compensation, leveling, or performance evaluation systems, ideally across several countries.

**Skills**

* Analytical rigor and a data\-driven approach to decision\-making.
* Ability to dive into detail, hold a high execution standard, and connect teams to the company's vision.
* Ability to operate under pressure, at a fast pace of growth, and in an environment of ambiguity and quick decision\-making.
* Excellent communication skills at all levels of the organization.
* Interest and passion for developing high\-performing teams, leadership, and corporate culture to achieve ambitious goals.
* An interest in the education sector and genuine motivation and commitment to the project will be positively valued.
* Fluency in English and Spanish is required. Catalan is a plus.

##### **What can you expect from us?**


Our culture and values defines who we are and how we work. We believe that how we do things matters just as much as what we do. We know this isn’t the right place for everyone —and that’s okay. Here’s what you can expect when joining our team:

* **We aim high:** We set ambitious goals and work to high standards. We’re driven by the conviction that improving education is a game changer —and we’re here to take it on with determination and passion. Here, you’ll be able to grow as much as you want!
* **We are owners:** From day one, you’ll take real responsibility and have real impact. We make thoughtful decisions, take initiative, and turn ideas into action —you’ll feel trusted to lead projects, make decisions, and watch your ideas come to life.
* **We move fast:** We work in a dynamic, ever\-evolving environment where speed and adaptability make the difference. Things move fast —and so do we. You’ll feel the pace, the energy, and the thrill of learning and acting quickly to make things happen.
* **We are eager to learn:** Our team is made up of curious, motivated people who challenge themselves —and each other— to grow. We value those who approach every challenge as a learning opportunity and bring a positive, solution\-oriented mindset, because here, every day is a chance to learn something new and share it with others.
* **We are humble:** We’re guided by feedback and collaboration. We listen actively, learn from one another, and value ideas for their impact —not for who they come from. You’ll find teammates who boost you up, challenge you kindly, and celebrate wins as a team.
* **We enjoy the ride:** Our impact depends on the people who make it possible. We’re an international, passionate team that thrives in a fast\-paced, high\-energy environment where intensity and purpose go hand in hand. We believe that a strong culture of trust, flexibility, and care is what makes our impact sustainable. We take care of our people so they can take care of our mission —offering flexible working hours, time off during the Christmas break, and flexible compensation options. And of course, we make space to reconnect and recharge through team\-building days that bring us closer and remind us why we do what we do.


If you think you are that person we are looking for **we would love to meet you!**

title: Economic Research & Business Intelligence Sr. Analyst
description:
Economic Research \& Business Intelligence Sr. Analyst
Country: Spain
**IT STARTS HERE**

Santander (www.santander.com) is evolving from a **global, high\-impact brand** into a **technology\-driven organization** , and our people are at the heart of this journey. **Together** , we are driving a **customer\-centric transformation** that values bold **thinking, innovation** , and the **courage to challenge** what’s possible.


This is more than a strategic shift. **It’s a chance for driven professionals to grow, learn, and make a real difference** .


Our mission is to contribute to help more **people and businesses prosper** . We embrace a strong risk culture and all our professionals at all levels are expected to take a proactive and responsible approach toward risk management.


**The Economic Research Area** is institutionally responsible for preparing and coordinating all macroeconomic forecasts for Santander Bank for the Group’s main forums and Committees. It also conducts macroeconomic and macro\-financial analysis of the Group’s key countries and business units, while advising Senior Management on the economic scenarios relevant to strategic decision\-making


Within the department, the Latin America area coordinates the macroeconomic analysis of the countries where Santander has a presence in the region and integrates local perspectives into a coherent regional view connected to the Group’s global economic outlook. It also participates in the design and preparation of the macroeconomic scenarios used in planning processes and stress\-testing exercises, in close collaboration with the local Economic Research teams and the relevant corporate areas.


**THE DIFFERENCE YOU MAKE**

**The Economic Research Area** is looking for a **Head of Economic Analysis for Latin America** based out of **Madrid** .


We are looking for a senior or semi\-senior macroeconomist with coordination capabilities, sound analytical judgment and an independent, well\-founded economic view, capable of integrating perspectives from different countries and contributing to the development of the regional view of Latin America and its connection to the Group’s global economic outlook. The candidate should combine strong hard skills (economic analysis, proficiency in econometric software and, preferably, programming) with sound soft skills (teamwork, negotiation and public speaking).


We’re **shaping the way we work** through innovation, cutting\-edge technology, collaboration and the freedom to explore new ideas. To succeed in this role, you will be responsible for:


* Coordinate the macroeconomic analysis of Latin America, integrating the perspectives of local economic teams into a coherent and consistent regional view connected to the Group’s global economic outlook.
* Develop and update an independent, well\-founded economic view of Latin America, identifying the region’s main trends, risks and opportunities.
* Participate in the design, preparation and monitoring of the macroeconomic scenarios used in the Group’s planning, budgeting and stress\-testing processes, in collaboration with the local Economic Research teams and contributing independent judgment to the definition and challenge of the scenarios.
* Analyze economic, financial and political developments in the region’s main countries, assessing their implications for Santander.
* Ensure the consistency and quality of the economic forecasts, scenarios and narratives developed for the different Latin American countries, challenging their assumptions when necessary.
* Act as a coordination point between the region’s Economic Research teams and the relevant corporate areas, facilitating the integration of the regional and global views.
* Prepare reports, presentations and briefings to support the head of the area in interactions with senior management and corporate committees, as well as the planning and risk areas, translating complex economic issues into clear and relevant messages.
* Contribute to cross\-functional projects related to planning, risk management and macroeconomic analysis, providing the Latin American economic perspective.
* Drive continuous improvement in the methodologies, tools and processes used for economic analysis and scenario development.
* Promote the responsible and efficient use of artificial intelligence, automation and data analysis tools to enhance productivity and the quality of analytical work.
* Contribute to the development of other team members through knowledge transfer, guidance and review of their work.
* Represent Banco Santander at various forums and events on Latin America.

**WHAT YOU’LL BRING**

Our people are our greatest strength. Every individual contributes unique perspectives that make us stronger as a team and as an organization. We’re **enabling teams to go beyond** by valuing who they are and empowering what they bring.


The following requirements represent the knowledge, skills, and abilities essential for success in this role. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.


**Professional Experience**

* Solid experience in macroeconomic analysis, economic forecasting, scenario design and coordination, or macro\-financial risk assessment. (Required)
* Experience in preparing, challenging and defending macroeconomic forecasts and economic scenarios. (Required)
* Experience coordinating projects or work involving multiple stakeholders, teams and geographies. (Required)
* Experience preferably gained in economic research departments, financial institutions, central banks, international organizations, research centers or universities. (Required)
* Knowledge of Latin American economies and the main risks and trends affecting the region. (Preferred)

**Education**

* Bachelor’s degree in Economics or related disciplines. (Required)
* Postgraduate education, Master’s degree or PhD in Economics, Econometrics, Finance, Statistics or related fields. (Preferred)

**Languages**

* High level of spoken and written Spanish and English. (Required)
* Knowledge of Portuguese. (Preferred)

**Hard Skills**

* Strong knowledge of macroeconomics, international economics and emerging markets. (Required)
* Strong knowledge of econometrics and quantitative methods applied to forecasting, modeling and macroeconomic analysis. (Required)
* Experience in applied economic analysis, forecasting and scenario development. (Required)
* Proficiency in programming and data analysis tools such as Python, R, Matlab or Stata. (Preferred)
* Familiarity with generative artificial intelligence and automation tools applied to economic analysis and information processing. (Preferred)

**Soft Skills**

* Analytical ability and judgment to develop evidence\-based conclusions.
* Ability to synthesize information and communicate complex economic messages to different types of audiences.
* Global perspective and ability to integrate analyses from different countries into a coherent regional narrative.
* Excellent written and oral communication skills.
* Ability to work independently and collaboratively in international and multidisciplinary environments.
* Ability to coordinate and manage stakeholders, with a results\-oriented approach, initiative and appropriate prioritization.
* Intellectual curiosity and interest in methodological innovation and new technologies applied to economic analysis.
* Rigorous and responsible approach to identifying and communicating macroeconomic risks.
