title: Senior Director, Individual Giving
description:
**Company Description** **About KIPP NYC:**  

Founded in 1995, KIPP NYC Public Schools is a non\-profit network of 18 free, public charter schools located in the Bronx, Brooklyn, and Manhattan. We partner with families and communities to create joyful, academically excellent schools where every child grows up free to create the future they want for themselves and their communities.


From our first middle school, KIPP Academy in the Bronx, to today’s network of eight elementary schools, nine middle schools, and one high school, KIPP NYC provides students with engaging academics, arts, athletics, and social–emotional learning that prepare them for college, career, and beyond.


Our commitment doesn’t end at graduation. Through KIPP Forward, we continue to support our alumni as they navigate college, career, and life, helping them define success on their own terms and pursue the paths that align with their goals and sense of purpose.


Together, we serve more than 9,400 students, support 4,700 alumni, and employ over 1,100 dedicated team members who bring passion, expertise, and commitment to our mission every day.

 **Job Description** **Position Overview:**


After 30 years of impact, KIPP NYC is entering an exciting new chapter. The Development Department is reimagining how philanthropy can deepen our impact and fuel our continued growth by building meaningful partnerships with individuals and institutions who believe in our mission and want to invest in joyful, academically excellent schools where students develop the skills and confidence to pursue the paths they choose.


The Senior Director, Individual Giving is a senior leadership role within the Development Department, responsible for shaping and growing one of KIPP NYC’s most promising revenue streams. The Senior Director will deepen relationships with individual donors and family foundations, inspire greater investment in our students and schools, and bring KIPP NYC’s mission and impact to life through authentic relationship\-building, compelling storytelling, and creation of meaningful donor experiences.


Reporting to the Chief Development Officer, the Senior Director will lead KIPP NYC’s individual giving strategy. They will manage a portfolio of donors and prospects, identify and cultivate new relationships, solicit intermediate and major gifts, and create engaging experiences that bolster donor connection and encourage lasting philanthropic support.


This role is ideal for a curious, entrepreneurially\-minded, self\-starter who is energized by the opportunity to build. The successful candidate will bring the initiative, creativity, and maturity to move seamlessly between vision and execution—partnering with KIPP NYC leaders, board members, and school communities while helping shape the organization’s next chapter.


This is a full\-time position with a hybrid schedule, requiring a minimum of three in\-person days per week based out of our KIPP NYC Midtown Manhattan office. The role also includes travel to KIPP NYC campuses across the Bronx, Brooklyn, and Manhattan. The cadence and frequency of school visits will be determined by your leadership team.

**Duties and Responsibilities:**


General responsibilities include (but are not limited to):

**Individual Giving and Portfolio Management**

* Own and drive the strategy for and personally manage and grow a portfolio of 75–100 individual donors and family foundation prospects.
* Develop and execute individualized moves\-management strategies, guiding donors from identification and qualification through cultivation, solicitation, and stewardship.
* Personally solicit and secure intermediate and major gifts by developing compelling proposals and presentations that align donor and family foundation interests with KIPP NYC’s mission, strategic priorities, and funding needs.
* Lead the preparation of high\-quality proposals and grant reports for family foundations, translating complex programmatic information into clear, compelling, and compliant narratives.
* Develop and maintain deep knowledge of KIPP NYC’s programs, priorities, and impact to effectively articulate a compelling case for investment in KIPP NYC’s students, schools, and communities.

**Donor Cultivation, Stewardship, and Events**

* Set and lead a year\-round donor cultivation and stewardship strategy that strengthens relationships, increases engagement, and supports donor retention and growth.
* Set the strategy for and lead donor and volunteer events, programs, and other strategic gatherings that strengthen relationships and move prospects through the giving pipeline.
* Curate meaningful donor experiences, including salons, dinners, school visits, and intimate convenings that bring KIPP NYC’s mission and impact to life.
* Partner with program and school\-based teams to create authentic opportunities for donors to engage with KIPP NYC’s students, educators, programs, and impact while ensuring experiences are thoughtful, respectful, and aligned with organizational priorities.

**Prospect Development and Fundraising Strategy**

* Serve as a strategic partner to the Chief Development Officer in proactively identifying and qualifying new major\-gift and family foundation prospects and building a strong, sustainable pipeline of prospective supporters.
* Leverage research, data, networks, and AI\-powered insights to expand and strengthen the prospect pipeline and identify new opportunities for philanthropic investment.
* Lead analysis of portfolio and pipeline performance to identify trends, opportunities, and areas requiring additional focus.
* Use donor data, portfolio performance, and engagement insights to set and continuously refine fundraising strategies, prioritize relationship\-building efforts, inform resource allocation, and drive individual giving performance.

**Organizational and Leadership Collaboration**

* Serve as a strategic fundraising partner to organizational leadership and board members to advance high\-level donor and foundation engagement.
* Strategically engage and equip organizational leaders and board members as fundraising partners, developing briefings, talking points, solicitation strategies, and follow\-up plans that advance donor relationships and major gift opportunities.
* Serve as the primary liaison to KIPP NYC’s Leadership Council, our Young Professionals Board, cultivating strong relationships with members and partnering with the Council to advance donor engagement, fundraising, events, and broader Development priorities.
* Collaborate across departments to gather programmatic information, identify funding opportunities, and develop compelling donor communications that authentically reflect KIPP NYC’s work, priorities, and impact.
* Serve as a trusted advisor to internal stakeholders, connecting organizational priorities with opportunities for donor engagement, philanthropic investment, and long\-term revenue growth.

**Systems, Data, and Development Operations**

* Partner with the Director of Development Operations and Strategy to ensure donor information, activity, and moves\-management data are recorded accurately and promptly in the CRM.
* Establish and maintain strong portfolio\-management systems, including clear next steps, contact reports, solicitation plans, and revenue projections that support accountability and fundraising performance.
* Establish and monitor individual giving, donor engagement, and event performance goals and key performance indicators, using data and portfolio insights to evaluate results and continuously refine strategy.
* Own accurate forecasting, reporting, and analysis of the individual giving pipeline, providing the Chief Development Officer with clear visibility into revenue projections, pipeline health, and progress toward fundraising goals.

  

**Qualifications**  

* At least 8\-10 years of experience in development or advancement, with significant experience in individual giving and frontline fundraising.
* Demonstrated success managing a significant donor portfolio, securing major gifts, and developing strategies that strengthen donor cultivation, solicitation, stewardship, and long\-term engagement.
* Demonstrated experience developing and leading donor cultivation and stewardship strategies, including events and experiences that advance relationship\-building and fundraising goals.
* Exceptional strategic, analytical, and critical\-thinking skills.
* Ability to operate at multiple levels, from setting and leading high\-level fundraising strategy to personally executing and overseeing critical operational details.
* Demonstrated track record of using donor, portfolio, and pipeline data to set strategy, evaluate performance, forecast revenue, and inform fundraising decisions.
* Exceptional project\-management skills, with the ability to manage multiple priorities while maintaining close attention to detail.
* Exceptional interpersonal, relationship\-building, and influencing skills, with the ability to build trust and credibility with donors, senior leaders, Board members, school\-based teams, and external partners.
* Exceptional verbal and written communication skills, with the ability to develop compelling donor\-facing narratives, make a persuasive case for support, and authentically articulate KIPP NYC’s mission, priorities, and impact to a range of audiences.
* Strategic, creative, and analytical thinker who can navigate ambiguity, exercise sound judgment, and translate ideas into thoughtful solutions in a fast\-paced environment.
* Advanced proficiency in Google Workspace applications.
* Experience using CRM databases; Salesforce experience is preferred.
* Deep commitment to KIPP NYC’s mission and belief in the potential of all students to learn, grow, and create the futures they want for themselves and their communities.
* Demonstrates KIPP NYC’s values, including zest, grit, self\-control, hope, social intelligence, gratitude, and a sense of humor.

  

**Additional Information** **Compensation and Benefits:**


KIPP NYC offers a salary ranging from $132,870 \- $165,830 per year. Salary ranges at KIPP NYC are standardized based on role level and role function. Individual salaries are determined through a lens of equity, accounting for years of experience relevant to the role and scope of responsibilities, and are benchmarked against others within the same salary band.


KIPP NYC offers a generous benefits package, including, but not limited to, the following:

* Robust benefits that include medical, dental, and vision.
* 403(b) retirement plan with a 50% match after 6 months.
* Generous Time\-Off aligned with the school calendar
* Up to 12 weeks of 100% parental leave.
* Bright Horizon Back\-up Child and Elder care.
* Employer\-paid Life Insurance and Short\-term/Long\-term disability.
* Employee incentives include 8 Weeks paid Sabbatical after 10 years, annual professional development funds, and tuition reimbursement.

***This description is intended to describe the type of work being performed by a person assigned to this position. It is not an exhaustive list of all duties and responsibilities required by the employee.***

***This is a full\-time, in\-person role based in New York City*** **and will require travel to our schools. If you are not in a school\-based position, the cadence and frequency of travel to schools is determined by your leadership team. If you relocate outside of a commutable distance or out of the state of NY, your employment will be subject to review, which may include separation from KIPP NYC. It is important that you notify HR if you move or have plans to relocate.**

***KIPP NYC LLC does not offer visa sponsorship or work authorization.***

***KIPP NYC LLC is committed to creating a welcoming environment that includes employees with diverse backgrounds and experiences. We believe that enables us to better meet our mission and values while serving students and families throughout New York City.***

***KIPP NYC LLC is an Equal Opportunity Employer. KIPP NYC LLC is committed to the principles of equal employment opportunity for all employees and applicants for employment.***

title: Tennis Technical Lead - Data
description:
**Tennis Technical Lead (Data), Tennis**

**Location:** UK


You’ll spend the majority of the time either working remotely from home or from our London or Basingstoke office. You won’t be expected to travel often but may want or need to visit event(s) to get an in\-person view of how Data generation and distribution is performing and works in our operational workflows. Approximate ratio 85% Office / Remote Work, 15% On Site / Travel.

**Reporting to:** Tennis Technical Manager

**Tennis Technical Team** member alongside Technical Manager, Technical Project Managers and Technical Leads

**Why Hawk\-Eye \& Why Tennis?**
--------------------------------


Join us at Hawk\-Eye and be part of an exhilarating journey through the world of sports events. Our operations teams play a crucial role in delivering high\-quality experiences at major sporting events worldwide. These are the different areas that you can explore:

* **Technical**: Testing, improving and stress testing our systems to enhance the performance of our delivery across the tours.
* **Creative**: Working closely with TV directors and external broadcasters to provide statistics and storytelling of insights across tennis matches during live broadcasts.
* **Operations**: Reviewing, improving and strategising how we improve the efficiency of delivery across the globe.
* **Projects:** On\-site management of our service delivery across the globe. Liaising with external stakeholders to organise our technical requirements to be ready and sites to be prepared for our arrival, and to deliver our services to the deadline of the events.
* **Broadcast Production**: Rigging and directing live TV broadcasts across the Masters 1000s ATP tour.

 **» Who is the Tennis Technical Team?**


The Tennis Technical Team oversees all technical aspects of the department, including the planning and delivery of our technology at events, testing and roll out of new software releases and new products, and advising on hardware specifications. They also directly impact the long term product roadmaps for tennis through reporting bugs, feature requests and new ideas through to the Product and Development teams.


As Data Lead you will fit in as part of the technical pillar within Tennis. At each event there is a Technical Guarantee whose role it is to oversee our full technical delivery including the delivery of our data \- this includes the hardware and software set up of Hawk\-Eye’s Tennis Data Platform on site. It is this data platform that you as Data Lead will oversee and manage from event to event, ensuring we are producing data that is not only accurate but also distributed in a timely fashion to all contracted clients, meeting all quality of service requirements and service level agreements.


As part of the technical team you will also be regularly interacting with the Product team in order to report detailed findings on the Tennis Data Platform and to continuously move the product forward, ensuring that it is as easy to use as possible. You will also liaise with the Commercial team and Clients to understand all delivery requirements, new services \& products requiring data feeds, and advise on the contractual commitments of Hawk\-Eye’s data delivery. Equally you will play a pivotal role in educating the operations team to ensure they are best set up for success at every event.

 **» What the job is all about**


The role is all about managing the day to day data services that we deliver across all our Tennis events that take place around the globe. In 2021 we rolled out our Tennis Data Platform which manages and produces a whole host of data feeds that are then distributed at various latencies to clients and third parties, as well as used internally to drive products. The management of this live service is essential as well as the storage of the historical data for future use. Data capture and delivery is one of the key foundational services that we provide in the tennis market requiring technical expertise, high attention to detail and well organised individuals to manage it.


Alongside the day to day management of live delivery, the Data Lead will also be driving and testing improvements while working to bring new features to the Tennis Data Platform that improve various aspects of Hawk\-Eye’s overall service delivery at tennis events around the World. Equally, the Data Lead will be responsible for onboarding new clients, and supporting the testing of new feeds and features with existing clients.


Our data performance is constantly being assessed by meeting necessary contract service levels. A big part of this role will be producing and assessing data delivery reports, to provide both clients and senior tennis stakeholders with an accurate picture of our data performance from event to event, pinpointing areas of improvement and then helping to implement changes both technically and operationally to address those identified problem areas.


As well as being hands on with the data delivery and assessment, the ideal candidate for this role will also be capable of working with a team of people across operations, product and development teams, as well as clients. There will also be an expectation that this person can manage and coordinate a wider group of people through excellent communication and people management skills, in order to ensure both our live and post event data delivery is fully up to date throughout the tennis calendar year.


There is an expectation for them to have line management capabilities but it is not a requirement of this role.

 **» Overview of Responsibilities**

* Managing the data delivery schedule throughout the tennis calendar
* Day to day data configuration
* Quality control
* Report Generations (both internal and external)
* Data Delivery Assessment
* Operational Support
* Regression testing new releases of software \& testing new features
* Keeping on top of data development deliverables \& deadlines
* Onboarding and facilitating testing with new clients
* Reporting and Feeding back issues / improvements
* Data Storage Management
* Standardising/Aligning Old Data
* Data Access
* Managing and executing data reprocessing
* Full roadmap of the Data Delivery Platform

 **» What we need from you**

* University Degree or equivalent;
* Experience of working across a global business within a multicultural working environment;
* Experience introducing and executing new processes across a team;
* Excellent communication;
* Attention to detail;
* Proactive, organised, efficient with time, diligent, able to prioritise and be self\-sufficient;
* A good understanding of the global tennis events framework;
* Willingness to learn about cloud\-based architectures;
* Ability to be flexible with working hours;
* Have an interest in statistics;
* Some knowledge of programming languages
* Data Analytics Experience


Not necessary but advantageous:

* Experience using data and analytics tools such as Datadog and Splunk

 **We are…**

**Brave**: The Data Lead demonstrates courage by proactively facilitating collaboration between teams and stakeholders with diverse objectives, confidently navigating differences to achieve alignment and progress in problem\-solving initiatives.

**Owners**: Taking full ownership of their role, the Data Lead ensures the successful implementation of creative and operational strategies, driving excellence in processes and operations to meet the department's goals effectively.

**Inclusive**: The Data Lead promotes an inclusive environment by actively fostering collaboration and open dialogue within the team, ensuring diverse perspectives are considered in communication, influence, and collaboration efforts to achieve shared objectives.

**Equal Opportunity Employer**  

Hawk\-Eye is committed to fostering an inclusive and diverse workplace. We ensure all  

employees are treated fairly, regardless of gender, marital status, race, nationality, religion,  

age, disability, or union membership status. We value diversity and strive to create an  

environment where everyone can reach their full potential.  

  

**Apply Today!**  

This is a fantastic opportunity to join Hawk\-Eye Innovations and make a significant impact in sports technology. If you're looking for a role where you can solve real\-world problems at scale, we’d love to hear from you!

title: Director, Solutions Design Engineer
description:
**Position Summary**



Are you passionate about developing innovative supply chain solutions that accelerate business growth, drive operational excellence, and create long\-term value for customers? ID Logistics is seeking a Senior Director, Solutions Engineering to lead complex solution design initiatives across North America while serving as a strategic partner to Commercial, Operations, Finance, IT, and Customer Implementation teams. Reporting to senior leadership within Research \& Development Department, this role primarily focuses on new business opportunities ensuring solution designs are operationally sound, financially viable, and aligned with customer requirements.

The ideal candidate brings extensive distribution center design experience, previous ownership of complex RFQ/RFI processes, advanced engineering and operational modeling capabilities, a proven track record leading high\-impact supply chain transformation initiatives, and in\-depth experience with customer implementations.

Candidates may see multiple related openings and are encouraged to apply for the role that best aligns with their background and career goals.


**Work Location:** Hybrid in Johns Creek, GA. Relocation assistance will be considered on case by case basis


**Work Schedule:** Monday\- Friday, 8:00am \- 5pm

**Competitive Compensation:** $124,000\-$160,000 plus performance based annual bonus


**Key Responsibilities**


**Strategic Solution Design Leadership**


* Lead the design and development of comprehensive logistics solutions supporting new business opportunities, customer expansions, network redesigns, facility start\-ups, contract renewals, automation initiatives, and operational transformations.

* Develop innovative supply chain solutions that leverage automation, technology, and best practices to improve productivity and service performance.

* Ensure all proposed solutions align with operational capabilities, customer expectations, financial objectives, and long\-term scalability.
* Validate operational assumptions, engineering designs, labor requirements, and financial models prior to customer presentation and implementation.
* Manage and oversee projects completed by other engineers to validate operational design, productivity, customer requirements, and financials.


**Commercial \& Business Development Support**


* Serve as a strategic engineering partner for commercial and operational team throughout the logistics sales lifecycle.
* Lead solution design activities associated with Requests for Information (RFI), Requests for Proposal (RFP), and Requests for Quotation (RFQ) opportunities
* Develop cost models, labor assumptions, throughput projections, and pricing strategies for new business opportunities and renewals.
* Partner with Commercial and Finance leadership on pricing strategies, business case development, and investment recommendations.
* Support proposal development, customer presentations, solution reviews, site visits, operational assessments, and executive discussions.
* Collaborate with customers to understand business objectives, operational challenges, growth forecasts, and service requirements.
* Validate commercial conditions, presentations, and financials on projects completed by other engineers


**Engineering Excellence \& Continuous Improvement**

* Maintain engineering standards, methodologies, design tools, templates, and best practices across the solutions engineering function.
* Lead value engineering initiatives focused on improving productivity, service levels, safety, quality, and cost efficiency.
* Evaluate automation technologies, robotics, material handling equipment, ASRS systems, goods\-to\-person solutions, and emerging supply chain technologies.
* Identify opportunities for network optimization, transportation improvements, inventory flow enhancements, and operational efficiencies.
* Drive data\-driven decision making through advanced analytics and operational modeling.
* Support implementation teams during customer onboarding, facility launches, and major operational transitions.


**Team and Cross\-Functional Leadership**


* Develop and train a team of solutions engineering professionals with various degrees of experience.
* Provide coaching and technical guidance to solutions engineering team members.
* Lead cross\-functional project teams supporting strategic customer initiatives and business growth objectives.
* Partner with Operations, Commercial, Finance, IT, Customer Implementation, and Procurement teams to develop integrated supply chain solutions.
* Collaborate with customers, vendors, equipment providers, consultants, and external partners as required.
* Support the development and standardization of engineering methodologies, tools, templates, and best practices.
* Actively promote a culture of innovation, accountability, collaboration, customer focus, and continuous improvement.


**Project Governance \& Customer Implementation Support**


* Manage, and oversee multiple concurrent engineering projects with significant operational and financial impact, while meeting deadlines and customer expectations.
* Monitor project milestones, engineering deliverables, assumptions, risks, business outcomes, and financial impacts.
* Support implementation and operations teams during customer launches, facility start\-ups, and major operational transitions.
* Present strategic solution recommendations and business cases to leadership and customers.
* Collaborate with equipment suppliers, consultants, technology vendors, and external partners to support engineering initiatives.
* Ensure compliance with company safety standards, operational best practices, and customer and quality requirements.

Requirements:
**Minimum Qualifications**


* Bachelor's degree in Industrial Engineering preferred; suitable candidates may have a degree in Mechanical Engineering, Systems Engineering, Supply Chain Management, Operations Research, Business, or a related discipline.
* Minimum of 8 years of progressive experience in solutions engineering, industrial engineering, logistics engineering, supply chain consulting, warehouse design, operations, or a related field.
* Minimum of 5 years of leadership experience managing solution design functions, or complex cross\-functional initiatives.
* Extensive solution design experience required. Experience, preferably within a third\-party logistics (3PL) organization.
* Proven experience leading large\-scale distribution, fulfillment, and supply chain solution development efforts, including labor modeling, process optimization, facility layout development, and financial costing.
* Demonstrated expertise in labor modeling, warehouse design, process optimization, facility layout development, capacity planning, and operational costing.
* Significant experience leading complex RFQ, RFI, and RFP responses, including solution development, pricing support, customer presentations, and contract pursuits.
* Strong understanding of warehouse operations, distribution center designs, transportation networks, inventory strategies, material handling systems, automation, and supply chain technologies.
* Expertise with Microsoft Excel, proficiency with AutoCAD, PowerPoint, and data analysis tools. Warehouse Management Systems (WMS) experience is a plus.
* Exceptional analytical, project management, communication, presentation, stakeholder management, and customer\-facing skills.
* Ability to own and manage multiple projects in a fast\-paced environment.
* Understanding of financial modeling, ROI analysis, and capital investment evaluation experience.
* Ability to travel up to 25%, with occasional periods of 50%.


**Preferred Qualifications**


* Master's degree in Engineering, Supply Chain, Business Administration, or a related field.
* Experience supporting highly complex operations within e\-commerce, omnichannel retail, consumer packaged goods (CPG), fashion, healthcare, automotive, industrial, food \& beverage, or consumer electronics sectors.
* Experience leading regional, national, or multi\-site solution design organizations Demonstrated experience evaluating and implementing automation technologies, robotics, autonomous systems, and advanced material handling solutions.
* Experience with network modeling, transportation optimization, facility location analysis, and supply chain strategy initiatives.
* Knowledge of Lean Six Sigma Black Belt, PMP, APICS/ASCM, or similar professional certifications preferred.
* Experience supporting operations exceeding one million square feet, highly automated environments, or large\-scale enterprise logistics transformations preferred.

title: Senior AI/ML Engineer (Prime)
description:
**Make an Impact Where It Matters Most**
----------------------------------------


At Intelliforce, we are building AI\-powered capabilities that move beyond experimentation and into real operational use. In this role, you will design, build, evaluate, and deploy AI and machine learning solutions that help teams work with complex data, automate analysis, and solve difficult mission problems.


You will work across generative AI, agentic systems, machine learning, data science, and production software engineering. From building LLM\-powered applications and intelligent agents to developing predictive models and production data pipelines, you will help take ideas from prototype through deployment while keeping performance, reliability, security, and scalability in focus.

**What Makes This Opportunity Stand Out**
-----------------------------------------


This role gives you the chance to work across the full AI lifecycle rather than owning one narrow piece of it. You will build agents, experiment with new models, develop traditional machine learning solutions, work with large and complex datasets, design evaluation strategies, and help determine which approaches are ready for production.


The work is especially well suited for someone who understands that successful AI engineering is more than connecting an application to an LLM. You will think about retrieval, orchestration, tool use, evaluation, latency, cost, data quality, model behavior, production monitoring, and the software engineering required to make AI dependable.

We are seeking a highly technical, data\-driven BI Analyst to support a small number of high\-value enterprise accounts. Working alongside an Account, Strategy and Media Directors, you will own the analytical layer for each assigned client \- generating performance insights, producing forecasts, and surfacing the patterns that drive business outcomes. You will operate fluently inside client\-owned data warehouses such as BigQuery, Snowflake, and Sigma, build BI environments in tools like Power BI/Tableau, and translate ambiguous business questions into structured analytical work. This role centers on developing a deep quantitative understanding of each client's business and using that fluency to inform strategy, investment, and forecasting decisions. The position plays a critical cross\-functional role between Strategy, Paid Media, Client Services, and Analytics.

**What You'll Do**


Data Analysis \& Insight Generation

* Synthesize large, multi\-source datasets across paid media, web, CRM, ecommerce, offline conversions, and call tracking into clear performance narratives
* Conduct deep\-dive analyses on channel contribution, funnel efficiency, audience segmentation, LTV, CAC, MER, and cohort behavior
* Surface hidden patterns, anomalies, and opportunities by applying statistical methods to complex, multi\-dimensional datasets
* Translate raw data into business\-aligned insights tied to revenue, pipeline, retention, and growth outcomes
* Partner with Strategy leadership to inform testing roadmaps, investment decisions, and budget reallocation


Forecasting \& Predictive Modeling

* Build and maintain forecasting models for revenue, spend, CAC, ROAS, CPA, and other KPIs across paid channels, ecommerce, and lead\-gen environments
* Develop scenario models (baseline vs. optimized) that project incremental opportunity from strategic shifts
* Apply seasonality decomposition, time\-series methods, and regression\-based projection techniques
* Quantify the financial impact of audit findings, optimization recommendations, and budget changes
* Surface leading indicators of underperformance before they appear in lagging metrics


Business Intelligence \& Data Visualization

Working Within Client Data Environments

 Cosign is on a mission to expand access to housing by helping landlords approve more qualified renters without increasing risk. We partner with owners and property managers to close the qualification gap caused by conditional approvals, thin credit files, and the absence of guarantors, materially improving leasing conversion and occupancy. We're building toward a near future where every U.S. property offers Cosign to renters who struggle to qualify, expanding housing choice while helping owners and operators convert demand into signed leases.
 



  





**OUR HIRING PHILOSOPHY** 




  





 At Cosign, we seek exceptional talent with relentless intellectual curiosity, individuals who:
 



  




* Challenge the status quo and drive continuous improvement
* Demand excellence from themselves and their colleagues
* Identify and solve problems others don't even recognize
* Create innovative solutions others believe impossible



  





 We deliberately seek these rare, high\-impact performers who attract similar talent. While most companies avoid hiring these exceptional individuals due to their demanding nature, we actively pursue them. When we find someone extraordinary, we move quickly to bring them onboard.
 



  





 We believe average talent builds average companies. By assembling a team of exceptional performers, we're creating the talent density needed to transform the rental industry and set new standards of excellence.
 



  





**THE OPPORTUNITY** 




  





 Calling all storytellers and brand builders. We're looking for a strategic, hands\-on Communications Manager who can own how Cosign shows up everywhere, externally and internally, from leadership's LinkedIn to the sales deck in a rep's hand. You will build the communications function from the ground up and define how Cosign sounds at every touchpoint.
 



  





 As our first
 
 Communications Manager
 
 , you will own the entire stack: owned\-channel strategy across LinkedIn, blog, website, PR, and executive communications, plus the messaging frameworks, sales collateral, and enablement materials that arm Sales, Partnerships, and Customer Success to sell with confidence. You will build the content engine behind our executive thought leadership and our Partnerships team's outreach, while partnering closely with leadership to keep every customer\-facing message clear, consistent, and on\-position.
 



  





 Reporting to the Head of Marketing, this is a player\-coach role: you'll ship high\-stakes content yourself while coaching and upskilling a Copywriter, raising the bar for every piece of writing that leaves the company. It is ideal for someone who thrives in a startup environment, has built a communications function from 0 to 1 before, and is excited to own the full narrative, inside and outside the company, in a fast\-moving, early\-stage context.
 



  





**KEY RESPONSIBILITIES** 




  




* Own Cosign's external communications engine across LinkedIn, the website, blog, PR, executive communications, and every customer\-facing channel, ensuring a consistent, compelling brand voice at every touchpoint
* Own the communications strategy end\-to\-end: editorial direction, messaging frameworks, brand voice, content planning, and cross\-functional alignment across Marketing, Product, Sales, and Customer Success
* Build executive thought leadership that positions Cosign as an industry leader: managing leadership's LinkedIn presence, executive content, presentations, speeches, interviews, and other public\-facing communications
* Drive the content and SEO strategy that builds awareness and authority: owning website messaging, blog content, organic growth, and continuously improving search performance in partnership with our design lead
* Lead PR, strategic communications, and high\-impact initiatives: partnering with the Head of Marketing on media opportunities, AI\-driven marketing initiatives, product launches, and company\-wide communications projects
* Own sales enablement and internal messaging from strategy to execution: creating and maintaining presentations, one\-pagers, case studies, battlecards, sales templates, launch communications, FAQs, webinars, and messaging documentation, ensuring every team tells a consistent story to prospects, customers, partners, and investors
* Coach and develop our Copywriter as a player\-coach: setting the quality bar, giving structured feedback, and upskilling them on voice, AI\-assisted workflows, and editorial judgment



  





**ABOUT YOU** 




  





 As a highly motivated and data\-driven communications expert, you take full ownership of the communications function, from messaging strategy to final content execution, without needing direction. You are deeply committed to your targets, remain structured under pressure, and distinguish true impact from mere output.
 



  





 You thrive in early\-stage landscapes where processes are still evolving. Instead of seeing gaps as obstacles, you view them as chances to innovate, bring fresh ideas, and find energy in constructing something new rather than simply working inside it.
 



  





 You are a storyteller at heart, comfortable adapting your voice across executives, customers, partners, media, and internal teams, and using SEO insights and AI to drive the highest\-performing content.
 



  





**PREFERRED EXPERIENCE** 




  





 We are looking for a passionate communications leader who is excited to shape Cosign's voice and build a world\-class communications function from the ground up.
 



  




* 3\-5\+ years of experience in Communications, Content Marketing, Corporate Communications, Editorial, Brand Marketing, or a related field, ideally within a startup environment
* Exceptional writing and editing skills, with experience creating content for executives, customers, sales teams, partners, and media while maintaining a consistent brand voice
* Proven experience building executive thought leadership, particularly on LinkedIn, and growing organic brand presence through strategic content
* Hands\-on ownership of website content, company blogs, editorial calendars, and SEO\-driven content strategies using tools such as Ahrefs, SEMrush, or Google Search Console
* Strong AI fluency, leveraging tools like ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, or similar platforms to accelerate research, content creation, and editing workflows
* Experience creating sales enablement materials, including presentations, one\-pagers, case studies, battlecards, and messaging frameworks, that support revenue teams throughout the customer journey
* Excellent project management skills, with experience coordinating multiple stakeholders and managing editorial workflows using tools like Notion, Asana, or similar platforms
* Strong cross\-functional leadership and the ability to influence Product, Sales, Customer Success, Partnerships, and executive stakeholders without formal authority
* A passion for building systems from scratch, balancing strategic thinking with hands\-on execution in a fast\-paced, high\-growth environment



  





**WHAT MAKES THIS OPPORTUNITY DIFFERENT** 




  





 This is an opportunity to join one of the fastest\-growing companies in U.S. PropTech at a pivotal moment in our growth. You will shape how Cosign communicates with the world, building the voice, content engine, and communications strategy that define our brand across customers, partners, investors, and the broader industry.
 



  





 You will work alongside a team of exceptional performers, partner directly with senior leadership, and have real ownership over strategy and execution from day one. From building executive thought leadership and scaling our content engine to shaping company messaging and sales enablement, your work will have a direct impact on our growth and market presence.
 



  





**WORKING AT COSIGN** 




  





 This is a remote role, with our Marketing team centered around Mexico City. We believe great work happens through both flexibility and connection, so you'll have regular opportunities to collaborate with teammates in person through weekly meetups and team gatherings.
 



  





 Cosign is looking for someone who thrives in a fast\-paced, high\-ownership environment and is excited to build alongside an ambitious team. We'll give you the autonomy to make an impact, the support to grow, and the opportunity to help shape both our communications function and the future of housing.

title: Senior Couture Pattern Maker & Sample Maker ( freelance )
description:
Senior Couture Pattern Maker \& Sample Maker

We are looking for a freelancer highly experienced and technically skilled Senior Couture Pattern Maker \& Sample Maker to join our fashion atelier.

The ideal candidate must be able to take a design from concept or sketch through the full garment\-development process, including pattern making, draping, fabric cutting, garment construction, fitting, alterations, and couture\-level finishing.

This role requires someone with strong technical knowledge, excellent craftsmanship, and the ability to work independently on complex womenswear and couture pieces.

Key Responsibilities

\* Interpret fashion sketches, reference images, and creative direction and translate them into technically feasible garments.

\* Create accurate patterns from sketches, measurements, existing garments, or draped toile.

\* Draping directly on the mannequin to develop silhouettes, volume, gathers, pleats, asymmetric shapes, and flowing designs.

\* Prepare toiles and prototypes for fitting and development.

\* Cut fabrics accurately, including delicate and luxury materials such as silk, chiffon, organza, satin, lace, tulle, crepe, and other couture fabrics.

\* Construct complete garments from first sample through final piece.

\* Perform both machine sewing and high\-quality hand sewing.

\* Apply couture finishing techniques, including invisible hems, hand finishing, internal finishing, delicate closures, and clean seam construction.

\* Understand garment structure, balance, fit, proportion, and movement.

\* Conduct fittings and make necessary pattern and garment adjustments.

\* Develop solutions for internal garment support, boning, lining, interfacing, corsetry, and structured areas when required.

\* Work carefully with complex draping, bias\-cut garments, layered fabrics, and intricate silhouettes.

\* Ensure every garment meets a very high standard of craftsmanship, fit, and finishing.

\* Recommend appropriate construction methods based on the design and selected fabric.

\* Minimize fabric waste while maintaining accurate cutting and quality.

\* Maintain organized patterns, samples, and garment\-development records.

\* Work closely with the Creative Director to develop and refine each design while maintaining the original creative vision.

Required Experience \& Skills

\* Strong professional experience in couture, bridal, eveningwear, luxury womenswear, or high\-end bespoke fashion.

\* Advanced pattern\-making skills.

\* Advanced draping skills.

\* Excellent fabric\-cutting ability.

\* Excellent machine\-sewing and hand\-sewing skills.

\* Strong understanding of garment construction and couture finishing.

\* Ability to work with delicate, expensive, and difficult fabrics.

\* Strong knowledge of women’s garment fitting and alterations.

\* Ability to understand a sketch and independently determine how the garment should be constructed.

\* Experience creating samples and prototypes from the development stage through the final garment.

\* Excellent attention to detail and precision.

\* Strong problem\-solving skills when translating creative designs into wearable garments.

\* Ability to work independently and manage several designs during collection development.

Preferred

\* Experience working in a couture atelier, bridal house, luxury fashion house, or bespoke studio.

\* Experience with evening gowns, draped dresses, corsetry, and complex silhouettes.

\* Knowledge of embroidery, embellishment, fabric manipulation, and hand\-applied details is an advantage.

\* Experience developing garments from original designer sketches rather than only following existing patterns.

What We Are Looking For

We are specifically looking for someone who is not limited to one technical area. The candidate should be capable of managing the complete garment\-development process:

Sketch → Draping / Pattern Making → Toile → Fitting → Pattern Correction → Cutting → Sewing → Couture Finishing → Final Garment

The right candidate should combine technical expertise with an understanding of design, proportion, movement, and luxury craftsmanship.

Pay: AED500\.00 \- AED5,000\.00 per month

Work Location: Hybrid remote in Dubai (Dubai)

* Budgets, analytics and forecasting
* Team performance and growth

  

You will effectively operate Savvy as the business owner and be responsible for turning products into profitable, scalable ecommerce businesses.

 **NON\-NEGOTIABLE EXPERIENCE**



Candidates must have meaningful hands\-on experience in ALL of the following areas:

 **1\. ECOMMERCE / DTC**  

* Personally operated or materially scaled an ecommerce or DTC business
* Strong understanding of Shopify, Amazon, marketplaces and/or direct\-response ecommerce
* Understand the full online customer journey from traffic through purchase, fulfillment and repeat purchase
 **2\. ONLINE MARKETING**  

* Strong practical knowledge of performance marketing
* Paid media, affiliates, publishers, media buyers or traffic partners
* Understand CPA/CAC, ROAS, RPC, CVR, AOV and LTV
* Experience improving offers, landing pages, checkout, creative, bundles, upsells and conversion
* Able to decide quickly whether to scale, change or stop an offer based on economics
 **3\. LOGISTICS \& INVENTORY**  

* Inventory planning and purchasing
* Demand forecasting
* Stockouts and excess inventory
* Supplier coordination
* Warehousing and fulfillment
* Shipping and logistics
* Working\-capital implications of inventory decisions
 **4\. CUSTOMER SERVICE**  

* Experience managing customer\-service operations in an ecommerce environment
* Understand refunds, returns, chargebacks, complaints and service levels
* Able to identify customer\-service problems that are hurting conversion, retention or profitability
* Experience building or managing processes that improve customer satisfaction while controlling cost
 **BUSINESS \& P\&L**


* Own revenue, gross margin, contribution margin, profit, budgets and forecasts
* Manage marketing spend and operating costs
* Review business performance frequently and take corrective action quickly
* Ensure every major product and channel has clear unit economics
* Manage cash and working capital with discipline

 **PRODUCTS \& SOURCING**


* Continuously identify strong new product opportunities
* Evaluate demand, competition, margin and scalability
* Work directly with suppliers and sourcing teams
* Negotiate price, MOQ, terms, production and lead times
* Understand landed COGS
* Manage product launches and seasonal planning
* Decide what to launch, scale, improve or discontinue

 **MARKETING, TRAFFIC \& OFFERS**


* Own positioning and offer strategy
* Approve pricing, bundles, discounts, upsells and recurring\-revenue opportunities
* Direct landing pages, advertorials, checkout, creative and video strategy
* Build relationships with affiliate networks, publishers, media buyers and traffic partners
* Negotiate payouts and commercial terms
* Secure profitable traffic at scale
* Expand winning offers into new channels and geographies

 **INVENTORY, FULFILLMENT \& CUSTOMER EXPERIENCE**


* Own inventory planning and purchasing decisions
* Prevent stockouts and excessive inventory
* Improve monetization of existing inventory through offers, bundles and upsells
* Coordinate suppliers, warehouses, fulfillment and logistics partners
* Ensure fulfillment problems do not interrupt sales
* Own customer\-service performance, returns, refunds and chargebacks
* Ensure service issues are identified and fixed quickly

 **PERFORMANCE \& ANALYTICS**



You must actively understand and manage:


* Revenue
* Gross margin
* Contribution margin
* Net profit
* CPA/CAC
* ROAS
* RPC
* CVR
* AOV
* Affiliate payouts
* Payment approval rates
* Refunds and chargebacks
* Inventory levels and turns
* Recurring revenue
* Customer lifetime value
* Customer\-service KPIs



Decisions must be based on economics and data, not opinion.

 **WHO WE WANT**



We want a proven owner\-type ecommerce operator, not a corporate administrator.



The ideal candidate has already run, built or materially scaled an ecommerce, DTC or direct\-response consumer\-products business and understands both sides of the business:

 **CUSTOMER ACQUISITION \+ OPERATIONS**



That means you must be comfortable moving in the same day between:


* Reviewing CPA and ROAS
* Improving an offer or funnel
* Negotiating with a supplier
* Reviewing inventory and forecasts

* Reviewing customer\-service issues

Strong candidates will have:


* Senior leadership experience

* Proven ecommerce/DTC operating experience
* Strong online performance\-marketing knowledge
* Experience launching and scaling products
* Strong sourcing and supplier\-negotiation experience
* Inventory and logistics experience
* Customer\-service management experience
* Shopify/direct\-response experience
* Strong financial and analytical ability
* Strong technology and practical AI skills
* Excellent English

  

International ecommerce, Asian sourcing, Amazon, affiliate marketing, recurring revenue and payment optimization are strong advantages.

 **THIS ROLE IS NOT FOR YOU IF**


* You have never run or materially scaled ecommerce
* Your experience is primarily offline retail, manufacturing or traditional corporate operations
* You know brand marketing but not performance marketing
* You cannot explain CPA, ROAS, CVR, AOV and LTV

 **WHAT SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE**

title: Interior Design Associate Director
description:
TGP International is looking for an experienced and highly creative Senior Associate / Associate Director to join its studio.

  

TGP International is a global hospitality consultancy based in London, Dubai, and Cairo. We partner with ambitious brands, clients, and entrepreneurs to turn their visions into successful hospitality experiences through concept development, interior design, branding and graphic design, advisory, franchising, operations, and project management. Our multidisciplinary team brings together interior designers, brand designers, strategists, advisors, chefs, and hospitality operators. This combination of creative and commercial expertise makes TGP an exciting environment for people who are passionate about food, hospitality and creating memorable guest experiences.

  

We are looking for someone who shares that passion. Someone inspired by the opportunity to create world\-class restaurants, bars, food halls, and hospitality destinations, and who understands how exceptional design can transform the guest experience.

  

While TGP is an established international consultancy, we retain a strong entrepreneurial spirit. This is a senior role within our Interior Design team, offering significant studio responsibility, client exposure, and the opportunity to contribute directly to exciting hospitality projects.  

  

**Key Responsibilities:**  

**Design Expertise**

* Deliver world class creative solutions across multiple small, medium, and large\-scale projects simultaneously, and across multiple geographies (UK, Europe, Asia and Middle East)
* Lead projects and the creative process from concept to delivery; with proven track record of strong design narrative where storytelling remains at the heart of the project throughout its development
* Lead and contribute hands\-on to concept development and design presentations, test fits, spatial planning, and 3D models, with a strong focus on guest experience and operational functionality
* Review detailed drawing packages, finishes and FF\&E specifications ensuring technical requirements and design intent are successfully co\-ordinated, including liaising effectively with clients, consultants, contractors and suppliers throughout the design and delivery process
* Demonstrate deep knowledge of design detailing, materials, finishes, fixtures and furniture, including fabrication and construction processes
* Build and maintain strong professional relationships with suppliers, manufacturers, makers, and other industry partners

 **Project Leadership \& Management**

* Take accountability for the successful creative and commercial delivery of projects to TGP’s quality standards
* Maintain oversight and remain actively involved and hands\-on throughout the entire project process, from initial concept through to design development, documentation, and delivery
* Make informed decisions regarding project resourcing, priorities, workflows, and allocation of responsibilities across internal teams including weekly resource tracking and coordination of project scheduling
* Manage projects effectively against agreed programmes, budgets, contractual scope of services, and commercial requirements
* Identify project risks and challenges early and work proactively with leadership team to resolve them
* Provide clear and timely reporting to the leadership team on project progress, resourcing, and key issues

 **Team Development \& Management**

* Foster a collaborative and supportive environment in which knowledge and best practice are openly shared
* Lead, mentor and train junior team members to support their professional and creative development, and maximise team performance and quality design output
* Support department resource planning, forecasting, project allocation and ad\-hoc department admin
* Manage workloads and workflows across multiple concurrent projects, ensuring teams are appropriately supported
* Contribute positively to TGP’s studio culture and help maintain an environment that encourages collaboration and creativity

 **Client Engagement**

* Proactively manage existing client relationships, ensuring that opportunities for repeat work are maximised
* Present creative concepts and design thinking clearly, confidently, and persuasively to senior client stakeholders
* Actively engage with opportunities to develop new business, enhancing internal and external communications via events, forums, and publications
* Support the preparation of fee bids, RFPs, and fee negotiations on projects

 **Software Proficiency**

* Adobe Suite
* AutoCAD
* SketchUp
* PowerPoint
* Microsoft Office


Experience with the following would be advantageous:

* Miro
* Asana

  

The role is based in our Covent Garden studio in London, with a hybrid working model of three days per week in the studio, and two days working remotely from home.

 **Requirements** **What we are looking for:**


We are looking for an accomplished hospitality designer and creative leader who combines exceptional design ability with strong project, team, and client leadership.


The successful candidate will have:

* 10\+ years' professional experience in interior design or interior architecture, with significant experience in hospitality and F\&B environments
* An outstanding portfolio demonstrating exceptional creative quality across restaurants, food halls, bars, and other hospitality and commercial environments having worked through Riba stages 1\-6
* A proven ability to develop emotive, narrative\-driven, and design\-led concepts and experiences, across projects of varying scales and geographies
* Strong creative leadership, with the ability to take projects from initial concept and storytelling through design development and delivery, including technical and construction expertise
* The confidence and experience to operate autonomously, with minimal supervision from leadership team
* Strong leadership and mentoring capabilities, with experience developing and managing design teams
* Commercial awareness and an understanding of project programmes, budgets/value engineering, contracts, fees, and resourcing
* Excellent client\-facing, presentation, and communication skills
* A collaborative, adaptable, no\-ego approach, and a commitment to contributing positively to studio culture
* A bachelor’s degree in interior design, Interior Architecture or a related discipline from an accredited institution, or equivalent professional qualification
* The right to work in the UK

 **Benefits** **TGP International employee benefits:**

* Hybrid work arrangement: three days in the office and two days working remotely
* Company incentive scheme offering up to 5 to 10 per cent for introductions and 5 per cent for successful closures
* Remote work flexibility: one additional week per year to work remotely from your home country, which can be combined with up to two consecutive weeks of annual leave
* Structured professional development through a dedicated coaching and mentoring program
* Annual company gathering: a global team event bringing together employees from all offices
* An employee recognition program: regular recognition initiatives celebrating outstanding performance and contributions

A. POSITION PURPOSE  

  



The Director of Athletics Creative Services Video Production leads the creation, editing, and distribution of video content for Santa Clara Athletics. This role develops video strategies to promote the Athletics brand, showcase student\-athletes and teams, engage audiences, and support marketing, communications, recruiting, fundraising, ticketing, sponsorship, social media, digital, and in\-venue efforts. The director manages projects from concept through distribution, establishes production standards, supervises staff and contractors, and serves as the primary contact for video projects with the West Coast Conference, University Marketing and Communications, and the School of Communication while supporting creative campaigns and maintaining a consistent athletics visual identity.


B. ESSENTIAL DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES
 

Program Direction and Development


* Develop, direct, and implement a comprehensive video content strategy\-for the athletic department while constantly evaluating and enhancing our product.
* Lead the creation of compelling, high\-quality video content for social media, digital platforms, in\-venue presentation, marketing campaigns, and other departmental initiatives in collaboration with departmental colleagues and external partners. Manage the department’s video archive and digital asset\-management processes, ensuring footage is properly organized, maintained, and readily available for conference, broadcast, news media, institutional, and departmental needs.

.


* Recruit, train, schedule, supervise, and provide creative direction to student employees, on\-call staff, freelancers, and independent contractors supporting Athletics video production.

Video Production Leadership and Brand Standards


* Establish and maintain the creative direction, visual style, and production standards for video content distributed through in\-venue, social media, digital, broadcast, and other departmental platforms.
* Produce and adapt video content for Santa Clara Athletics and team\-specific channels, ensuring each asset is appropriate for its intended audience, format, platform, and campaign objective.Collaborate with media relations, marketing, ticketing, development, coporate partnerships, coaches, and other departmental stakeholdersto generate ideas and execute content that supports brand, engagement, recruiting, and revenue goals.
* Provide advice, consultation, and support in the development of policy, planning, and response to all video and digital content management aspects of the Department of Athletics.
* Review video content for creative quality, technical accuracy, brand consistency, accessibility, and compliance with applicable University, conference, and NCAA requirements before distribution.

Content Production and Event Coverage


* Lead video content strategy and production for men’s basketball at home and on the road, coordinating coverage, priorities, and distribution with the assigned communications contact and other departmental stakeholders.
* Conceive, research, script, direct, film, edit, and deliver short\- and long\-form video content, including team highlights, behind\-the\-scenes features, student\-athlete profiles, interviews, promotional pieces, motivational content, and season\-ending projects.
* Create video and motion\-graphic elements for in\-venue presentation, digital platforms, social media, marketing campaigns, recruiting initiatives, development efforts, and other departmental priorities.
* Lead video coverage of home and away competitions, practices, community service activities, departmental events, and other Athletics initiatives, including highlights, interviews, social\-first content, and feature storytelling.
* Coordinate broadcast\-adjacent and independent event coverage by assigning and directing videographers, identifying required shots and deliverables, and ensuring appropriate coverage for sports with and without a live broadcast.
* Conceptualize and produce video content showcasing Santa Clara Athletics facilities, programs, people, and campus environment.
* Prepare, publish, or coordinate the distribution of video content through approved Athletics channels and content\-management systems, following established editorial, brand, accessibility, and approval procedures.
* Select and properly license music, footage, graphics, and other creative assets used in video productions.

External Video and Media Coordination


* Serve as the primary Athletics video contact for the West Coast Conference, University Marketing and Communications, broadcast partners, local and national news media, visiting institutions, and other authorized external organizations.
* Coordinate and fulfill approved footage requests, ensuring video assets meet required formats, specifications, deadlines, usage rights, and University and departmental policies.

Digital Asset and Equipment Management


* Maintain an organized, searchable, and secure digital video archive using the department’s digital asset management and storage systems, including consistent standards for file naming, metadata, access, backup, retention, and retrieval.
* Maintain an accurate inventory of video\-production equipment and coordinate its storage, checkout, routine maintenance, repair, and replacement.
* Assess video\-production technology and equipment needs and provide recommendations to the external unit leader or future purchases and upgrades.

Production Staff Supervision and Development


* Recruit, onboard, train, schedule, supervise, and evaluate student employees, on\-call staff, game\-day production assistants, freelancers, and independent contractors supporting Athletics video production.
* Assign personnel and manage coverage schedules for designated sports, home events, road competitions, and departmental initiatives based on production priorities and available resources.
* Establish clear expectations for capturing, editing, delivering, and publishing content, including compliance with creative standards, deadlines, platform requirements, and approved social media access procedures.
* Provide regular instruction, constructive feedback, and professional\-development opportunities that improve technical skills, creative judgment, reliability, and overall production quality.
* Review and approve time records and required employment documentation in coordination with Athletics administration and Human Resources.

Liaison responsibilities.


* Serve as the primary Athletics contact with University Marketing and Communications for video\-production requests, footage coordination, brand alignment, and collaborative content initiatives.
* Develop and maintain partnerships with the School of Communication that create mutually beneficial opportunities for student learning, internships, production experience, and Athletics content development.
* Identify, establish, and manage campus partnerships and collaborative video projects that advance Athletics’ creative and departmental priorities.

Other duties as assigned.
 

1\. Must maintain current knowledge of applicable rules and standards of the West Coast Conference, NCAA, and Santa Clara University.  



  

C. PROVIDES WORK DIRECTION


Supervises and provides work direction to on\-call employees (student/non\-student) and independent contractors.  



  

D. GENERAL GUIDELINES


Recommends initiatives and implements changes to improve quality, services, and operational efficiency.


Identifies opertational challenges and their causes and \- develops recommendations for improvement of established processes and practices. Maintains productive relationships with departmental stakeholders and solicits feedback to improve creative services and support.


Maximizes productivity through the effective use of appropriate tools; training, workflows, and performance practices.


Researches and develops resources that support timely, consistent, and efficient workflow.


Tracks project progress, communicates significant changes or deviations from established goals, and ensures the completeness, accuracy, and timely delivery of operational work.


Prepares and submits reports as requested and required.


Develops and implements guidelines and standard operating procedures that support the effective operation of the unit.  

  



  

E. QUALIFICATIONS  

  



To perform this job successfully, an individual must be able to perform each essential duty satisfactorily. The items below are representative of the knowledge, skills, abilities, education, and experience required or preferred.


This position requires the ability to effectively establish and maintain cooperative working relationships within a diverse multicultural environment.  



  

Knowledge


* Demonstrated expertise leading all phases of professional video production, including pre\-production, field production, post\-production, and distribution.
* *Comprehensive knowledge of pre\-production practices, including story development and research, creative pitching, location scouting, scriptwriting, interview preparation, production scheduling, staffing, and logistical planning.*
* *Comprehensive knowledge of field\-production practices, including camera operation, composition, lighting, audio recording, equipment setup and breakdown, live\-event coverage, and interviewing student\-athletes, coaches, administrators, alumni, donors, and other subjects.*
* *Comprehensive knowledge of post\-production practices, including footage evaluation, editing, media organization, audio mixing, color correction, motion graphics, captioning, quality control, encoding, and delivery.*
* Advanced knowledge of professional video\-production equipment, workflows, file formats, storage systems, and digital asset\-management systems.
* Advanced proficiency with relevant creative software, including Adobe Premiere Pro, After Effects, Photoshop, Audition, Media Encoder, and other applicable production tools.
* Knowledge of video strategy and storytelling practices for social media, digital platforms, in\-venue presentation, marketing campaigns, recruiting, fundraising, sponsorship, and broadcast use.
* Knowledge of visual identity and brand standards and the ability to apply them consistently across video content and creative campaigns.
* Working knowledge of copyright, music and footage licensing, publicity and privacy rights, accessibility practices, and other requirements governing video production and distribution.

Understanding of and commitment to the University’s mission and vision and the role of intercollegiate athletics within the institution.


Skills


* Advanced skill in operating professional cinema, mirrorless, DSLR, and video camera systems, including related lighting, audio, stabilization, and production equipment.
* Advanced proficiency with Adobe Creative Cloud applications relevant to video production, including Premiere Pro, After Effects, Photoshop, Audition, and Media Encoder.
* Demonstrated skill in visual storytelling, creative direction, videography, editing, motion graphics, audio production, color correction, and content optimization for digital, social, broadcast, and in\-venue platforms.
* Demonstrated ability to lead production crews and provide clear creative and technical direction to student employees, on\-call staff, freelancers, and independent contractors.
* Strong project management and organizational skills, including the ability to prioritize simultaneous projects, coordinate production schedules, manage resources, and meet firm deadlines.
* Strong written, verbal, and interpersonal communication skills, with the ability to collaborate effectively with student\-athletes, coaches, administrators, staff, alumni, donors, partners, media representatives, and other Athletics constituencies.
* Ability to present creative concepts, receive and provide constructive feedback, and translate stakeholder objectives into effective video content.
* Experience using CatDV or a comparable digital asset\-management system is preferred.
* Experience producing or incorporating aerial footage is preferred. FAA Part 107 certification, or the ability to obtain certification, is preferred when operating drones on behalf of the University.

  

Abilities


* Ability to translate departmental objectives and audience needs into clear, compelling, and platform\-appropriate video content.
* Ability to exercise sound creative judgment and maintain accuracy, discretion, and professionalism when working with student\-athletes, coaches, sensitive information, and time\-critical content.
* Ability to prioritize and complete multiple projects in a fast\-paced, deadline\-driven environment while adapting to changing schedules, competitive outcomes, and departmental needs.
* Ability to work independently, take initiative, and collaborate effectively as a member of a cross\-functional creative team.
* Ability to represent Santa Clara University and the Department of Athletics professionally when working with internal and external constituencies.
* Ability to build productive working relationships with individuals from varied backgrounds, roles, and areas of expertise.
* Ability to provide and receive constructive feedback and resolve creative or operational differences professionally.
* Ability to work frequent evenings, weekends, and holidays and travel for home and away athletic events and other departmental assignments.

Education


* A bachelor's degree in video production, journalism, or a related field is required, or an equivalent combination of education and/or experience is required.

Years of Experience

**Title:** Director, E\-Commerce

**Location:** Tampa, FL – Hybrid – 3 days onsite (Tues\-Thurs), 2 days WFH (Mon\+Fri)

 **About the Company**


At Checkers \& Rally's were redefining what fast food can look like.  

  

From Day one, our mission has been simple: deliver bold, crave\-worthy food at an unbeatable value, without slowing down. That’s why we’ve built a brand known for iconic menu items, fast service, and experiences that keep guests coming back again and again. From the Big Buford to our award winning Famous Seasoned Fries, our menu Eats Different!  

  

But what really sets us apart? Our people.  

  

We believe in creating opportunities. Whether you're starting out or building your career, we provide the training, support, and real pathways to help you grow, lead, and succeed.

 **About the Role**

The Director of e\-Commerce is responsible for driving profitable growth across all digital ordering channels, including first\-party (owned app, website, kiosk) and third\-party (delivery marketplace) sales. This role owns the strategic and day\-to\-day management of e\-commerce partner relationships, digital sales performance, and the operational infrastructure that supports it — including the delivery help desk and the cross\-functional QA, IT, and Creative request processes required to keep digital ordering platforms running smoothly across the system.


This is a hybrid strategic/operational role: the Director will set the growth agenda for digital sales while also ensuring the day\-to\-day machinery — support, quality assurance, technical integrations, and creative execution — runs reliably at scale across franchise and/or company\-owned locations.

 **What You’ll Do (Core Impact Areas)**

 **Digital Sales Growth (1st \& 3rd Party)**

* Own the growth targets for all digital ordering channels, including owned app/web ordering and third\-party marketplaces (e.g., DoorDash, Uber Eats, Grubhub).
* Develop and execute strategies to grow digital order volume, average check, frequency, and digital mix as a percentage of total sales.
* Identify and prioritize new digital revenue opportunities (loyalty integration, personalization, virtual brands, catering, subscriptions, etc.).
* Build and monitor KPIs/dashboards for digital sales performance; report results and insights to executive leadership.
* Partner with Marketing to align promotional calendars, offers, and loyalty strategy across 1st and 3rd party channels.

 **Partner Relationship Management**

* Serve as the primary point of contact and relationship owner for all third\-party delivery and e\-commerce platform partners.
* Oversee commercial terms, contracts, and renewals with delivery marketplaces and technology vendors. Partner with Procurement for major terms adjustments.
* Lead quarterly business reviews with partners to evaluate performance, resolve issues, and identify joint growth initiatives.
* Stay current on partner platform updates, new features, and competitive positioning; recommend adoption where it drives business value.

 **Delivery Help Desk Oversight**

* Own the performance and operations of the delivery help desk supporting restaurant teams with order issues, platform outages, and delivery escalations.
* Establish SLAs, staffing models, and escalation protocols to ensure timely resolution of field and guest\-impacting issues.
* Analyze help desk trends to identify systemic problems and drive root\-cause fixes with partners or internal teams.
* Ensure help desk processes and tools scale with order volume and new restaurant openings.

 **Cross\-Functional Process Ownership (QA, IT, Creative)**

* Manage the intake and execution of QA processes to ensure menu accuracy, pricing integrity, and platform functionality across all digital ordering channels.
* Partner with IT on integrations, POS connectivity, platform troubleshooting, and technical rollouts related to e\-commerce channels.
* Manage the Creative request pipeline for digital assets (app/web content, marketplace storefronts, promotional creative), ensuring brand standards and timelines are met.
* Build repeatable, documented workflows across QA, IT, and Creative to reduce turnaround time and errors as the digital business scales.
* Act as the connective tissue between Marketing, Operations, IT, and Creative teams to ensure digital initiatives launch smoothly and on time.

 **Leadership \& Cross\-Functional Collaboration**

* Build, lead, and develop a team supporting e\-commerce operations, partner management, and help desk functions (structure may include direct reports and/or matrixed resources).
* Partner closely with Operations to ensure restaurant\-level execution supports digital sales growth.
* Collaborate with Finance on digital sales forecasting, commission structures, and profitability analysis by channel.
* Present digital business performance and strategic recommendations to senior leadership and franchise stakeholders.

 **What You Bring (Must\-haves)**

 **Must\-Haves (required):**

* 7\+ years of experience in e\-commerce, digital marketing, or off\-premise sales, with demonstrated leadership experience.
* Direct experience managing relationships with third\-party delivery marketplaces (DoorDash, Uber Eats, Grubhub, etc.).
* Proven track record of driving measurable digital sales growth.
* Experience managing cross\-functional processes involving IT, QA, and Creative teams.
* Strong analytical skills; comfortable with dashboards, reporting tools, and data\-driven decision\-making.
* Excellent negotiation, communication, and stakeholder management skills.

 **Nice\-To\-Haves (preferred):**

* Restaurant, retail, or multi\-unit franchise industry experience.
* Experience with POS systems, digital ordering platforms, and delivery integration technology.
* Experience overseeing a support/help desk function.
* Familiarity with loyalty programs and personalization/CRM platforms.

 **Benefits**

* This role is Bonus eligible
* Medical, Dental, and Vision Benefits available
* Competitive PTO Policy with Paid Holidays Off
* 401k w/ a company match
* Cell Phone Reimbursement
* Employee Discount at restaurants

 **Why Join us**

* Bold, performance driven\-brand
* Growth opportunities
* Strong team culture
* Focus on results and accountability
* CARE Program
* Top 10 Cruise Prize

 **Work Environment \& Essential Physical Requirements**

* **Location:** Tampa, FL – Hybrid
* **Travel Expectations:** Occasional travel for conferences, national c.
* Individual must live in the Tampa area and is required to be in the Restaurant Support Center or Innovation Center 3 days per week, at a minimum.
* Ability to sit for extended periods (4–6 hours/day) in a hybrid corporate or home office setting.
* Ability to stand, walk, and move throughout a corporate facility during in\-office days, employee meetings, or multi\-department coordination activities.
* Ability to communicate clearly and effectively in person, by phone, and via virtual platforms throughout the workday, including during sensitive or emotionally charged employee conversations.

 **Company Values**

* **We’re Fearless** – We take bold risks and push past limits with a “can\-do” spirit, tackling challenges creatively and fearlessly. We go beyond expectations and make every move count. Fearless isn’t just a mindset; it’s how we win.
* **We’re Family** – We’re a family, built on trust and respect, holding each other accountable and lifting each other up at every turn. Standing together, we create an environment where everyone thrives\-franchisees, teams, communities, and guests\-no exceptions.
